religious_tolerance.name: Religious Tolerance
religious_tolerance.desc: Our country is populated by people who practice different beliefs. Therefore, it would be prudent to govern in a tolerant manner with them, ensuring the support for our government regardless of their religion.

plutocratic_monarchy.name: Plutocratic Monarchy
plutocratic_monarchy.desc: A Monarchy that manages its finances by relying on the merchant class and securing the flow of commerce.

promotion_of_manufactures.name: Promotion of Manufactures
promotion_of_manufactures.desc: A capital-minded state takes an active hand in fostering its manufactures, letting us promote an additional industry across the realm.

the_combination_act.name: Restricted Worker Unions
the_combination_act.desc: Every measure has been taken to prevent future strikes. All unlawful formations of trade or labor unions are henceforth prohibited!

the_recruiting_act.name: Mandated Navy Service
the_recruiting_act.desc: Forcibly requiring any able-bodied person without means of income to enlist for naval service will undoubtedly cause some controversy...

national_assemblies.name: National Assemblies
national_assemblies.desc: An assembly composed of representatives of the entire nation. Depending on the type of government, it may have all the powers of government, or only legislative ones.

east_india_trading_company.name: East India Trading Company
east_india_trading_company.desc:
A global trading company, its original objective was to trade in the Indian Ocean region. These ventures proved fruitful, and the company later expanded its operations to East Asia.
It is now the largest company in the entire world, controlling and administering large sections of our overseas holdings and our myriad of global trade networks.

company_of_scotland.name: Company of Scotland
company_of_scotland.desc: We have granted a monopoly of overseas trade to this company, easing the administration of our trade network, granting us better returns of our government bonds and better control over subventions in return.

admiralty_regime_reform.name: Admiralty Regime
admiralty_regime_reform.desc: A government reform where the ruler is also the superior commander of the navy. Where other states have a fleet, this fleet possesses the state.

military_regime_reform.name: Military Regime
military_regime_reform.desc: A form of government where the ruler is picked from the staff of generals of the army. The government serves the army!

thalassocracy_reform.name: Thalassocracy
thalassocracy_reform.desc: Thalassocracy: rule by the sea. Ours is a people whose lives are lived out with, by, and for the ocean. Our empire stretches far beyond our homeland and into far-flung colonies in our extended Outremer, our Lands Beyond The Sea. From coast to coast beyond, our flags wave from ships upon the briny foam. The sea is cold, yet we have made it our home. Let no one challenge us in our proper element!

agricultural_cultivation.name: Agricultural Cultivation
agricultural_cultivation.desc: Crop output has been maximized by shifting focus from small-scale farming to the establishment of large plantations.

the_espionage_act.name: Black Chambers
the_espionage_act.desc: By using stealth and guile to intercept all kinds of written communications, we can stay ahead of our enemies and make our espionage more effective.

public_welfare_act.name: Public Welfare
public_welfare_act.desc: The poor suffer most in times of trouble. Some small donations shall help to ease their misery - and hopefully ensure that the mob will not pick up their torches and pitchforks...

religious_laws_enforced.name: Religious Laws Enforced
religious_laws_enforced.desc: Let us look much more closely to our holy scriptures to determine appropriate crimes and penalties for our society. After all, when a society is ruled in a truly pious fashion, it makes it far easier for devout citizens to weed out the traitors and deviants among them.

land_inheritance_act.name: Peasant Land Inheritance
land_inheritance_act.desc: By granting even the lowliest Commoners the right to inherit and continue using the lands of their forefathers, we shall gain productivity as a state.

the_education_act.name: Mandatory Bureaucrat Education
the_education_act.desc: Henceforth, education is compulsory for those who are to govern or otherwise work within our legal system.

the_loyalty_act.name: Counter-Espionage Offices
the_loyalty_act.desc: Loyal citizens who report dangerous elements in our territory will be greatly rewarded by the state. We will establish numerous offices to more effectively report such activities to our government.

vassal_obligation_act.name: Fixed Vassal Obligations
vassal_obligation_act.desc: Fix in law the precise military and economic obligations that our client states have towards us.

enlightened_aristocracy.name: Enlightened Aristocracy
enlightened_aristocracy.desc: Encourage education and high literary standards among the aristocracy in order to ensure that the leaders of our nation closely follow our Humanist ideals.

the_transportation_act.name: Transportation Code
the_transportation_act.desc: Establish a fixed system of transportation fees for goods to encourage the exportation of valuable items.

cultural_recognition_act.name: Cultural Recognition
cultural_recognition_act.desc: By recognizing the distinctive nature and valuable contributions of our minority cultures, we can better include them in matters of state.

licensing_of_the_press_act.name: Licensing of the Press
licensing_of_the_press_act.desc: We have adopted strict rules and regulations about what can be printed. Hopefully, this will silence anyone seeking to make treasonous or abusive statements about our society.

diplomatic_traditions.name: Diplomatic Traditions
diplomatic_traditions.desc: From time immemorial, our people have favored the word above the sword, giving us the ability to forge lasting relationships with our allies, and to build a reputation as honest and loyal.

patrimonialism.name: Patrimonialism
patrimonialism.desc: The government is run directly by the ruler as an extension of their household. Armies, bureaucrats, and subjects swear loyalty directly to the sitting ruler, and not to the state.

enforce_religious_adherence.name: Enforce Religious Adherence
enforce_religious_adherence.desc: Religious orthodoxy must be strictly maintained to ensure societal unity. Dissenters will be identified, controlled, and suppressed to prevent unrest.

harbor_administration.name: Harbor Administration
mods: Local Monthly Development Growth (Every owned coastal location will gain)
Proximity Impact through Port (Every owned coastal location will gain)
harbor_administration.desc: Port facilities must be efficiently managed to support maritime trade and naval operations. Corruption will be reduced, and commerce will thrive under structured supervision.

trade_office_network.name: Trade Office Network
trade_office_network.desc: A network of trade offices must be established to facilitate commerce and taxation. Centralized management will improve merchant interactions and state revenue.

exchange_of_ideas.name: Exchange of Ideas
exchange_of_ideas.desc: Not only do coin and profit move along the Silk Road, but ideas and knowledge also follow the ebb and flow of the merchants traveling along its path.

local_army_organization.name: Local Army Organization
local_army_organization.desc: Military recruitment and training must be localized for better response to regional threats. Supplies and logistics will be improved to strengthen provincial forces.

bank_ledgers_system.name: Bank Ledgers System
bank_ledgers_system.desc: Financial transactions and state expenditures must be meticulously recorded. A robust system of ledgers will ensure accountability and reduce fraud within the treasury.

plutocratic_ethos.name: Plutocratic Ethos
plutocratic_ethos.desc: The influence of wealthy elites in governance must be encouraged. Burghers and financiers will shape policies to promote economic expansion and private enterprise.

garrison_system.name: Garrison System
garrison_system.desc: Permanent military garrisons must be stationed in key locations to deter threats. Well-supplied and disciplined troops will ensure regional security and rapid mobilization.

colonial_expansion.name: Colonial Expansion
colonial_expansion.desc: Overseas territories must be acquired and settled with government support. Strategic investments in colonization will ensure long-term economic and political dominance.

mercenary_registration_act.name: Mercenary Registration
mercenary_registration_act.desc: Private military forces must be registered and regulated to ensure discipline. Mercenary companies will be held accountable, preventing instability and betrayal.

multilingual_diplomats.name: Multilingual Diplomats
multilingual_diplomats.desc: Foreign negotiations must be conducted by linguistically skilled diplomats. Multilingual representatives will strengthen diplomatic ties and improve trade agreements.

asymmetrical_warfare_tactics.name: Asymmetrical Warfare Tactics
asymmetrical_warfare_tactics.desc: Non-traditional combat strategies must be employed against superior forces. Guerrilla tactics, sabotage, and deception will be used to weaken enemy advances.

mining_communities.name: Mining Communities
mining_communities.desc: Resource-rich regions must be developed into organized mining communities. State supervision will ensure efficient extraction and stable labor conditions.

universal_serfdom.name: Universal Serfdom
universal_serfdom.desc: Commoners must be bound to the land to secure constant availability of agricultural labor. Nobility will be granted authority to oversee their estates with greater efficiency.

statute_of_monopolies.name: Statute Of Monopolies
statute_of_monopolies.desc: Selected Burghers must be granted exclusive trading privileges to regulate market competition. This will stimulate controlled economic growth and limit foreign interference.

state_backed_merchant_fleet.name: State-Backed Merchant Fleet
state_backed_merchant_fleet.desc: Naval trade operations must be supported by state funding. A well-maintained merchant fleet will boost commerce and provide auxiliary support for military endeavors.

naval_infrastructure_act.name: Administration of Shipyards
mods: Harbor Capacity (Every owned coastal towns and cities will gain)
naval_infrastructure_act.desc: Shipyards, docks, and coastal defenses must be expanded. Greater investment in naval infrastructure will ensure maritime supremacy and facilitate large-scale operations.

policy_of_calculated_delay.name: Policy Of Calculated Delay
policy_of_calculated_delay.desc: Strategic delays during negotiations are a great way to put our thumb on the diplomatic scale. By establishing ourselves as the strongest side in an exchange, through these tactics, we will inevitably extract more value from every foreign deal.

anti_heresy_act.name: Punishment of Heresy
anti_heresy_act.desc: Heresy and religious dissent must be rooted out through systematic suppression. Doctrinal purity will be maintained to prevent internal division and unrest.

administration_of_clerical_lands.name: Administration Of Clerical Lands
administration_of_clerical_lands.desc: Church properties and revenues must be placed under state supervision. Religious institutions will be monitored to align their interests with national policies.

humanitarian_administration.name: Humanitarian Administration
humanitarian_administration.desc: Social welfare initiatives must be implemented to improve public well-being. Addressing poverty and instability will strengthen state control and prevent revolts.

military_allotment.name: Military Allotment
military_allotment.desc: Land grants must be allocated to military officers to secure their loyalty. In return, they will maintain standing forces prepared for immediate deployment.

weapons_quality_standards.name: Weapons Quality Standards
weapons_quality_standards.desc: Strict standards must be enforced for military armaments. Rigorous inspections and regulations will ensure superior weapon durability and effectiveness.

diplomatic_consolidation_act.name: Consolidation of Diplomatic Affairs
diplomatic_consolidation_act.desc: Diplomatic policies must be centralized for more effective international negotiations. Long-term alliances and agreements will be maintained for stability.

provincial_taxation_system.name: Provincial Taxation System
provincial_taxation_system.desc: Tax collection must be standardized across provinces to ensure consistent revenue. Corrupt officials will be removed, and financial supervision will be strengthened.

conscript_logistics_act.name: Ministry of Conscript Logistics
conscript_logistics_act.desc: Military supply chains must be reorganized to improve troop mobility. More efficient logistics will ensure faster deployments and sustained campaigns.

mass_levy_system.name: Mass Levy System
mass_levy_system.desc: By instituting a system of mass conscription, we can draw upon the full population of our realm for military service. This broad mobilization swells our armies with common soldiers, embracing the philosophy that victory comes through numbers rather than individual skill.

free_market_charters.name: Free Market Charters
free_market_charters.desc: By granting charters that guarantee free trade and protect merchant interests, we encourage commerce to flourish across our realm. Wealthy trading classes gain political influence, shifting power away from the traditional nobility toward those who command capital.

representative_assemblies.name: Representative Assemblies
representative_assemblies.desc: By establishing representative assemblies that give voice to the common people, we decentralize authority and foster broader political participation. Local governance becomes more responsive, and individual liberties are enshrined as a cornerstone of our political order.

smooth_integration_act.name: Recognition of Local Policies
smooth_integration_act.desc: Newly conquered territories must be gradually assimilated to avoid resistance. Cultural and administrative policies will ensure a seamless absorption into the state.

centralization_of_power_act.name: Centralization Of Power
centralization_of_power_act.desc: Authority must be consolidated to limit regional autonomy. A strong central government will enhance decision-making efficiency and national stability.

horse_artillery.name: Horse Artillery Corps
horse_artillery.desc: Mobile artillery units must be deployed to increase battlefield flexibility. Rapid movement and powerful firepower will be combined for tactical superiority.

autonomous_estates.name: Autonomous Estates
autonomous_estates.desc: Local Nobility must be granted some degree of autonomy. Decentralized governance will prevent uprisings while maintaining feudal obligations to the central authority.

production_quota_bureaus.name: Production Quota Bureaus
production_quota_bureaus.desc: Manufacturing output must be regulated through government quotas. Centralized supervision will prevent shortages and maintain economic stability.

naval_armament_act.name: Prioritize Military Shipbuilding
naval_armament_act.desc: Shipbuilding efforts must be expanded to strengthen naval forces. Greater investment in warships will ensure maritime dominance and protect trade routes.

recordkeeping_act.name: Expanded Archives
recordkeeping_act.desc: Government records must be meticulously maintained for administrative efficiency. Accurate documentation will prevent corruption and streamline bureaucracy.

visionary_thinkers.name: Visionary Thinkers
visionary_thinkers.desc: Intellectuals and reformers must be supported to advance state policies. Innovative ideas will drive economic growth, military advancements, and governmental improvements.

organized_marines.name: Organized Marines
organized_marines.desc: Marine forces must be formally structured for amphibious warfare. Specialized training and disciplined formations will improve coastal and naval engagements.

mandatory_service.name: Mandatory Service
mandatory_service.desc: Military conscription must be enforced to maintain a strong standing army. All eligible citizens will be required to serve in defense of the state.

flexible_diplomatic_stance.name: Flexible Diplomatic Stance
flexible_diplomatic_stance.desc: Foreign policy must remain adaptable to shifting alliances. Strategic decisions will be made based on the evolving geopolitical landscape.

modern_assault_tactics.name: Modern Assault Tactics
modern_assault_tactics.desc: Offensive warfare doctrines must be refined for greater battlefield efficiency. New tactics will emphasize speed, coordination, and overwhelming force.

state_sponsored_markets.name: State Sponsored Markets
state_sponsored_markets.desc: Trade hubs must be established with state backing to encourage commerce. Government support will ensure fair pricing and economic growth.

nautical_education_act.name: Nautical Education
nautical_education_act.desc: Naval training programs must be expanded to improve leadership at sea. A more skilled officer corps will enhance fleet command.

constitutional_state.name: Constitutional State
constitutional_state.desc: The Constitutional State focuses on the delicate balance between the powers of central authority and representative institutions. While the head of state still governs, laws and policy decisions are shaped by a legislative body, in a valiant attempt to curb absolutist tendencies.

town_specialization.name: Tailored Urban Rights
mods: Monthly Development in towns and cities
town_specialization.desc: Urban settlements are the muscles that power our country. Their sprawl attracts the majority of our population, and their bustling economies provide both opportunities and benefits for all. If we provide them with the appropriate laws, regulations, and privileges, we can ensure that they are most beneficial for us, each according to their situation and needs.

capitalistic_cities.name: Fueling Economies
mods: Monthly Prosperity in towns and cities
capitalistic_cities.desc: Our economy is based on the industries of our towns and cities. Providing them with the adequate regulations will ensure that we maintain those industries functioning at their best performance, reducing costs and maximizing benefits.

righteous_government.name: Righteous Government
righteous_government.desc: Our rule is defined by the ancestral traditions of China, and the virtues of benevolence, righteousness, respect, wisdom, sincerity, and loyalty among many others are the guiding compass of our administration. Such government cannot but be blessed by Heaven itself.

national_traditions.name: National Traditions
national_traditions.desc: Not event the cultural might of China is able to influence our traditions. We are proud of our culture and heritage, and we will not allow any foreign influence to dictate the conditions and workings of our rule.

agrarian_community.name: Agrarian Community
mods: Grants Access to the Charter of Religious Freedom
agrarian_community.desc: Our lands are cultivated by people of many different beliefs and origins. Fostering a sense of community and centering their shared identity as our subjects will reduce friction and focus everyone on our common goals.

study_of_the_classics.name: Study of the Classics
study_of_the_classics.desc: To ensure the continued prosperity of our government, we shall establish a new system of education for our elite. With a newly established separate institution, we can ensure access to the highest quality tutors while keeping their efforts centered on those who deserve it the most. With our government supported by these efforts, in time this will inspire our population to aspire to the same level of education.

barony_rule_reform.name: Barony Rule
mods: Grants Access to the Strengthen family ties Subject Interaction
barony_rule_reform.desc: Our most capable nobles will ensure that our influence reaches not only the furthest corners of our realm, but fosters ties to our subjects as well. By sending minor members of our own family as ambassadors to our vassals, we can placate those who govern in our place, and ensure their oversight fulfills our will.

enlightened_leadership_reform.name: Enlightened Leadership
mods: Grants Access to the Commoner Council Rights
enlightened_leadership_reform.desc: Our leadership must be composed only of the brightest minds, no matter their heritage. This inspiring guidance for our people will ensure that our state will have an advantage against our rivals, both in governance and military affairs.

hermit_country_reform.name: Hermit Country
mods: Grants Access to the Annul Casus Belli Covert Action
hermit_country_reform.desc: Our country must remain resilient against foreign threats, even before rival powers can reveal their intentions. By carefully planning our diplomatic connections with foreign countries, we can reduce the risk of their fabricating pretexts for war against us.

shield_of_the_faith_reform.name: Shield of the Faith
mods: Grants Access to research the Fortress Church advance
shield_of_the_faith_reform.desc: We are the defender of the righteous, and will protect our brethren in faith from any who dare lay their hands upon them. People of the one true faith will be able to seek shelter in our mighty bulwarks, where no heathen can harm them.

enlightened_council_reform.name: Enlightened Council
mods: Grants Access to the Declare Holidays Parliament Request
enlightened_council_reform.desc: Our state must be guided by the principles of enlightened scholars. The councilors guiding our ruler must keep them well-informed and focused on the sole task of ensuring the wellbeing of all our subjects.

colonial_empire_reform.name: Colonial Empire
colonial_empire_reform.desc: Our empire spans over the vast oceans of the world, and our mighty fleets ship precious goods from one continent to another. Protecting our fleets and keeping our colonial possession safe from the influence of foreign merchants will ensure our lasting control over all corners of the world.

tyranny_of_the_capital_reform.name: Tyranny of the Capital
mods: Grants Access to the Align Estate cabinet action
tyranny_of_the_capital_reform.desc: We shall support the efforts of our capital to centralize power in the hands of the government. A constant presence of our authority and might will ensure the cooperation of our estates and prevent any uprisings against our rule.

noblesse_oblige_reform.name: Noblesse Oblige
mods: Grants Access to the Noblesse Oblige cabinet action
noblesse_oblige_reform.desc: The deeds of our upper class must exceed any expectations put on them, to be an inspiration for our people and serve as the model of the ideal citizen for them to emulate.

rural_oligarchy_reform.name: Rural Oligarchy
rural_oligarchy_reform.desc: The backbone of our economy is found in the raw goods of our land. By granting charters to our burghers to oversee those operations from local companies, we can guarantee a rapid and efficient expansion of our extractions.

everyone_serves_reform.name: Planned Storage System
mods: Grants Access to the Grain House Building
everyone_serves_reform.desc: Feeding our troops is no easy task, requiring both building up an infrastructure of Grain House facilities and filling these with the yearly harvest. At the same time, our people need to shoulder this additional contribution, otherwise our army would fail to protect our country effectively.

trade_guards_reform.name: Professional Trade Guards
trade_guards_reform.desc: In order to facilitate the flow of goods throughout our country and ensure the safety of every merchant setting foot on our territory, we should establish a permanent company of soldiers with the sole purpose of protecting our trade routes. Additionally, this organization shall also be tasked with the maintenance and construction of new roads.

provincial_consulates_reform.name: Provincial Consulates
mods: Grants Access to the Provincial Chancery Building
provincial_consulates_reform.desc: We can ease all foreign diplomacy by investing into a network of Provincial Chancery buildings. With that, we can ensure that foreign envoys can reach our representatives much faster and speed up our communication with foreign powers.

peasant_labor_rights_reform.name: Guaranteed Labor Rights
mods: Grants Access to the Oversee Labor Rights cabinet action
peasant_labor_rights_reform.desc: Giving our population the legal protection against those who wish to exploit them will help our land and people prosper. With a robust legal system protecting peasants and laborers from abuse, while also increasing their opportunity of education, we can achieve a long lasting increase of our productivity.

leader_of_nations_reform.name: Integration Offices
mods: Upon Annexation of a subject, we will no longer receive an opinion penalty with other subjects
leader_of_nations_reform.desc: The integration of our subjects territory into our own administration is a difficult task, made even harder by the negative sentiment carried to other countries. The establishment of new offices will be able to mitigate this, at least to those countries who already swear fealty to us.

new_elite_reform.name: Modernization of Urban Rights
new_elite_reform.desc: Many of our towns and cities cling to outdated rights, granted to them centuries ago. For those urban areas to remain competitive we must ensure their privileges remain sensible for their current status within our country.

bureaucratized_administration.name: Bureaucratized Administration
bureaucratized_administration.desc: The Roman tradition of orderly administration is the marrow of our state. By codifying offices, drilling clerks, and binding every magistrate to the same procedure, we ensure that the will of the center reaches every corner of our realm, and that the produce of every corner reaches the treasury.

citizenship_through_service.name: Citizenship Through Service
citizenship_through_service.desc: The legions of old were built on a simple promise: serve the state, and the state will name you one of its own. By extending citizenship and its privileges to those who bear arms for us, and to their sons after them, we open the ranks to every able body within our borders.

urban_guilds.name: Urban Guilds
urban_guilds.desc: Our cities are knots of trade and craft, and the guilds within them know their work better than any minister could. By granting our burghers the standing to organize, to set their own quality, and to invest in the countryside that feeds them, we let private ambition serve the public weal.

arsenal_of_the_realm.name: Arsenal of the Realm
arsenal_of_the_realm.desc: In the manner of the great Venetian shipyards, we shall centralize the building, repair, and supply of our fleet in a single arsenal under direct state oversight. Hulls laid down in the morning may be at sea by the season's end, and our captains will sail in the knowledge that our naval expertise stands behind every plank.

latin_tutors.name: Latin Tutors
latin_tutors.desc: The recovery of Latin letters has lit a fire across our schoolrooms and our courts. By placing tutors of the old tongue before our children, and before the children of those who will govern after us, we equip a new generation to read the ancients, draft our charters, and parley as equals with the lettered courts of Europe.

elite_condottieri.name: Elite Condottieri
elite_condottieri.desc: Why bleed our own subjects when there are companies of veteran captains who will fight for coin? By cultivating long contracts with the most disciplined of these condottieri, we keep their swords at our side and out of our rivals' purses, and our peasants behind the plow where they belong.

symphonia_doctrine.name: Symphonía Doctrine
symphonia_doctrine.desc: Realm and Church move as one: the basileus protecting the faith and the patriarchs blessing the throne. Where their two voices sing in harmony, both the state and the souls of our people are well governed, and the courts of the Clergy may sit beside our own to weigh the conduct of every congregation.

logothesion_of_the_drome.name: Logothésion of the Drome
logothesion_of_the_drome.desc: From a single office in the palace, the Logothete oversees couriers, envoys, and the great network of post roads that knit the realm together. No dispatch travels faster, no embassy is better prepared, and no road of ours is laid without his clerks recording every milestone.

revival_urbanization_movement.name: Urban Revival Movement
mods: Monthly Prosperity in towns and cities
Maximum RGO Size in Urban Locations
Monthly Development in towns and cities
revival_urbanization_movement.desc: Whole provinces lie scattered with the bones of cities long abandoned to the plow. By offering charters to those who would lead settlers back to these sites, and stones from the imperial quarries to those who would rebuild them, we begin the slow work of restoring the urban dignity of the realm.

revised_geoponika_hippiatrika.name: Revised Geoponiká and Hippiatriká
revised_geoponika_hippiatrika.desc: The old Geoponika and Hippiatrika gather the agricultural wisdom of antiquity into two great volumes - one on the fields and orchards, the other on the care of horses and beasts. A revised edition, pressed into the hands of every provincial governor, raises the yields of every estate and the strength of every stable in the realm.

new_farmers_directive.name: New Farmers' Directive
new_farmers_directive.desc: The realm has long stood upon the back of the smallholding farmer, and the venerable Farmer's Law has long protected him. By renewing its provisions for the present age, guarding the peasant's plot, easing his dues, and giving him a voice in his own commune, we turn the countryside from a source of grievance back into a wellspring of strength.

pax_hellenica.name: Panhellenismós
pax_hellenica.desc: From Constantinople to the furthest themata, Greek tongue and manner bind together a vast tapestry of peoples. By patient cultivation rather than the sword, through letters, liturgy, and the slow exchange of generations, we draw the realm into one cultural body, and quarrels that once divided whole provinces fade into agreement on what it means to be Roman.

papacy_reform.name: Holy See
papacy_reform.desc: The Holy See is the jurisdiction of the Bishop of Rome, the Pontifex Maximus, head of the Catholic Church, known as The ruler.

kingdom_of_god_reform.name: Kingdom of God
kingdom_of_god_reform.desc: We have established the Kingdom of God on Earth. The authority of the Church, led by the ruler, shall be absolute in both the spiritual and temporal realms.

celtic_traditions_reform.name: Celtic Traditions
mods: Prefers Court Language to be Common Language
celtic_traditions_reform.desc: The ancient ways of insular society have been incorporated into our current system of government. Our leader rules the people instead of the land, and trained poets take the place of Clergy in some formal ceremonies.

galley_lords_reform.name: Galley Lords
galley_lords_reform.desc: Though we are tethered to the land, the sea is our dominion.

magna_carta_reform.name: Magna Carta
magna_carta_reform.desc: The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the Crown. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.

sbl_restorer_of_the_disinherited.name: Restorer of the Disinherited
sbl_restorer_of_the_disinherited.desc: The lords disinherited by the treasonous Sco Robert De Brus 1St Lord Of Annandale now flock to our banner on our promise of restoring their rightful holdings!

irish_earldom_reform.name: Irish Earldom
irish_earldom_reform.desc: Our authority rests in the titles granted to us by the Lord of Ireland.

iron_ring_reform.name: The Iron Ring
iron_ring_reform.desc: Our entire administration is organized around maintaining the sheer number of castles that control our hills and valleys, making us one of the most fortified countries in the world.

sudebnik.name: Sudebnik
sudebnik.desc: The decision has been made to standardize our legal code, which originally developed as common law with significant regional variations. By streamlining this code and expanding the number of offenses subject to fines, we improve both administrative efficiency and state revenue.

oprichnina.name: Oprichnina
oprichnina.desc: The hereditary Nobility poses the greatest threat to our command of the state. We must break their power by seizing portions of their estates and redistributing this land to those who demonstrate loyalty to us.

prussian_monarchy.name: Monarchy
mods: Grants Access to the Militarize Country cabinet action
prussian_monarchy.desc: A form of government under a monarch, which puts great focus on administrative efficiency — especially in military matters, if the situation calls for it.

turkish_pashas.name: Pashas
turkish_pashas.desc: In the, the title of Pasha is bestowed by the Sultan upon high-ranking civil officials or military leaders. It is typically awarded to governors, and ranked above Beys and Aghas but below Khedives and Viziers.

tsardom.name: Tsardom
tsardom.desc: Our state upholds the legacy of the Roman Empire, and is a stalwart of our state religion. As Tsar of the entire Russia, our ruler is the true overlord of the East Slavic peoples.

bulgarian_tsardom.name: Bulgarian Tsardom
bulgarian_tsardom.desc: Our realm upholds the illustrious legacy of Simeon the Great and the emperors of the Tsardom who came before us. Acclaimed by both clergy and nobility, our ruler stands as the guardian of the faith and the cornerstone of South Slavic imperial power in the Balkans.

veche_republic.name: Veche Republic
veche_republic.desc: This state is governed by a Veche, a council with the highest legislative and judicial authority consisting of Nobility, Burghers, and even Commoners.

sovet_gospod.name: Sovet Gospod
sovet_gospod.desc: The Sovet Gospod — or the Council of Lords — is the decision-making institution of the Republic. Unlike the Veche system, the Sovet Gospod gives more power to Posadniks, Tysyatskys, and other members of the Nobility. Under this system, the influence of the Burghers and the Commoners is negligible.

compagna_communis.name: Compagna Communis
compagna_communis.desc: This is the meeting of all the trade associations of Genoa, and the noble lords of the surrounding valleys and coast, joining together to form the city's government.

diarchy_republic.name: Diarchy Republic
diarchy_republic.desc:
No man should rule a country alone, or else we are no better than the tyrannical despots who try to subjugate our people.
The Capitano del Popolo shall be a dual position where members of the Spinola and Doria families will each hold office. The rivalry between their alberghi keeps the Republic restless, but their Diarchs share the burdens of state and their countinghouses keep the coin flowing.

joint_ruling_monarchy.name: Joint Ruling
mods: Stability Decay (Our Ruler and their sibling will take turns ruling every 5 years)
Monthly Progress to Conciliatory (Our Ruler and their sibling will take turns ruling every 5 years)
Monthly Progress to Decentralization (Our Ruler and their sibling will take turns ruling every 5 years)
Set Cabinet Member Cost (Our Ruler and their sibling will take turns ruling every 5 years)
Replace Cabinet Member Cost (Our Ruler and their sibling will take turns ruling every 5 years)
Possible Government Reforms (Our Ruler and their sibling will take turns ruling every 5 years)
joint_ruling_monarchy.desc: Many princes still uphold the tradition of sharing power with their siblings — splitting the duties of governance, ruling their holdings jointly, or even taking turns on the throne for a pre-determined period.

great_and_minor_councils_of_genoa.name: Great and Minor Councils of Genoa
great_and_minor_councils_of_genoa.desc: Created by Admiral Andrea Doria after reforming the government, the Great and Minor Councils of Genoa are the two legislative bodies of the state. The Great Council represents the members of the Burghers while the Minor Council is made up of the Nobility.

alberghi_28.name: The Twenty-Eight Alberghi
alberghi_28.desc: After the political changes of the last century, the influential House of Doria is promoting a reform of the constitution, eliminating the factions that plagued our republic in the past. These factions are replaced by a new oligarchic government, which includes the twenty-eight most important families, referred to as the -Eight Alberghi.

conquistador_country.name: Conquistador Expedition
mods: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle
conquistador_country.desc: We are not a country; we are more like a small army of conquistadors, here to expand our glorious homeland! And to fill our pockets, of course.

banking_country.name: Banking Family
banking_country.desc: We are not a country; we are more like a family! Or rather, an extended family, all oriented around providing banking services to those in need.

wayfinders_reform.name: Wayfinders
wayfinders_reform.desc: Thousands of years of voyaging have taught our navigators how to traverse the seas. Bereft of advanced technology, the wayfinders memorize patterns in the stars and observe minute changes in the clouds and water to determine their position in the vast Pacific.

byzantine_court_in_italy.name: Byzantine Influence
byzantine_court_in_italy.desc: Despite having moved to Italy, the of Montferrat remain loyal to their Greek ancestry.

family_sagas_reform.name: Family Sagas
family_sagas_reform.desc: Our ancient sagas passed down orally through the generations tell of adventurous expeditions to a distant and wild land over the western sea. Perhaps one day we may follow in the footsteps of our forebears...

por_casa_de_india.name: Casa da Índia
por_casa_de_india.desc: The Casa da Índia oversees all possessions in Africa and India, and controls all the rights to trade there.

ven_monte_nuovo.name: Monte Nuovo
ven_monte_nuovo.desc: The original lending system in Italy was a joint stock fund called Monte Vecchio, in which each citizen was required to lend a certain amount of money in exchange for interest. But with this updated iteration, our bankers have introduced a guaranteed minimum interest payment to lenders, which has increased the amount of money people are willing to invest. This 'Monte Nuovo' has been extremely successful, and should prove extremely lucrative over time.

hun_power_to_magnates.name: Powerful Magnates
hun_power_to_magnates.desc: The powerful magnates of Hungary reduced the power of the Crown at every opportunity.

casa_de_contratacion.name: Casa de Contratación
casa_de_contratacion.desc: The Casa de Contratación is an agency that administers Spanish colonial operations. All voyages of exploration and trade must receive its approval, and it collects all colonial taxes. The Casa is also charged with safeguarding classified information about new trade routes and valuable discoveries.

spanish_tolerance.name: Iberian Tolerance
spanish_tolerance.desc: Iberia is inhabited by a multitude of people with different faiths and beliefs. To force them to follow one or to expel those with different beliefs than the ruling class would be a grave mistake, and hurt our country more than it would do good. For us to achieve greatness, we must embrace this diversity.

manuelan_architecture.name: Manueline Architecture
manuelan_architecture.desc: This innovative style synthesizes aspects of Late Gothic architecture with influences from the Spanish, Italian, and Flemish traditions. The construction in Manueline was largely financed by proceeds from the lucrative spice trade with Africa and India.

pyrenean_fueros_reform.name: Pyrenean Fueros
pyrenean_fueros_reform.desc: The Fuero is realized in written law, limiting royal power and ensuring the exercise of civil liberties. Only when new rulers swear to protect the Fueros are they recognized as such. The Fueros are the constitutions of the realm, subjecting power to the rule of law and expressing the balance of power between our state and our rulers.

ambrosian_republic_reform.name: Ambrosian Republic
ambrosian_republic_reform.desc: A scholarly system of rule, where academics and urban intellectuals hold political power rather than traditional nobility. This system is a government based on intellectual merit and civic participation rather than hereditary rule. The republic maintains control through popular support from the educated elite, though it faces condemnation from those who view it as a threat to the status quo.

warsaw_confederation.name: Warsaw Confederation
warsaw_confederation.desc: Every noble, regardless of their religious affiliation, shall be permitted to vote and to live their lives as they wish. Moreover, they shall have the right to convert their subjects to their faith as they see fit. This resolution shall turn us into a safe haven and will promote religious tolerance.

petition_of_rights.name: Petition of Rights
petition_of_rights.desc: The citizens within our borders, particularly those with noble connections, have long demanded the adoption of certain inalienable rights. These would impact the cooperation of our estates and our capacity for governmental reforms at the cost of a weaker central authority.

scottish_shires_reform.name: Shires of Scotland
scottish_shires_reform.desc: Introduced by Sco Malcolm Iii, the shire system divides Scotland into administrative counties, with each shire having its own structure.

ancient_french_taxation.name: Ancient Taxation
ancient_french_taxation.desc: Historically, taxes have been imposed and collected only in times of need, not by a recurrent system.

french_feudal_nobility.name: Feudal Nobility
french_feudal_nobility.desc: Feudalism has a tight grip on court affairs. Powerful nobles and autonomous, decentralized subjects have unprecedented amounts of freedom and say in our internal administration.

french_centralized_monarchy.name: Monarchy
french_centralized_monarchy.desc: Following centuries of heavy decentralization, France has consolidated many of its fragmented appanage and ducal lands, paving the way for a more modern state.

french_appanage_reform.name: Appanage
french_appanage_reform.desc: As Princes of the Blood, holders of appanages enjoy a higher standing among the subjects of France, as well as greater privileges. Furthermore, the monarch is expected to pay them adequate respect in exchange for their assistance in diplomatic affairs.

french_ducal_vassal_reform.name: Ducal
french_ducal_vassal_reform.desc: While the ducal subjects of France lack the autonomy of the appanage domains, they instead enjoy a more cooperative relationship with the Crown.

member_of_league_of_public_weal.name: Member of the League of Public Weal
mods: Disallowed from Call Subject to War
member_of_league_of_public_weal.desc: By becoming part of the League of Public Weal, we commit to joining any future wars waged against the ruler of France. But, should any such conflict fail, the crown would be emboldened to confiscate lands from disloyal subjects...

basic_timariot_system.name: Timar System
basic_timariot_system.desc: A system of feudal land holdings focused on building a formidable cavalry force. Our Sipâhi cavalrymen will be assigned land grants and obligated to provide cavalry forces proportional to the size of their holdings.

expanded_timariot_system.name: Expanded Timar System
expanded_timariot_system.desc: The system with landed Sipâhi supplying the bulk of our cavalry has been expanded, assigning them vast tracts of conquered land on which to continue amassing cavalry.

enderun_interior_service.name: Enderûn
enderun_interior_service.desc: The Interior Service is a complex branch of the household. Divided into the Privy Chamber, the Treasury, the Privy Larder, and the Great and Little Chambers, its ranks consist of a motley crew of eunuchs, slaves, and other little-noticed members of the royal household, who can sometimes wield remarkable influence over the inner workings of the state.

ottoman_imperial_harem.name: Imperial Harem
ottoman_imperial_harem.desc: The Imperial Harem is much more than a collection of enslaved beauties at the ruler's beck and call - it is an institution parallel to the Interior Service, with its own organization, education, and protocols. Though those in the harem must work behind the scenes, they can sometimes wield great influence, turning the tides of state with merely a whisper in the right ear.

ottoman_eunuch_viziers.name: Eunuch Viziers
ottoman_eunuch_viziers.desc: Skilled eunuch servants can be granted powerful positions such as Black Chief Eunuch, Kızlar Ağası, and White Chief Eunuch, Kapı Ağası. In these roles, they are responsible for communications between the ruler and the, as well as administration of the harem and pages, supervision of waqf foundations, and the education of princes, among many other things. Considered more trustworthy than their intact peers, they can be relied on to always work for the benefit of the state.

sekban_system.name: Sekban System
sekban_system.desc: Sekban soldiers are recruited in large numbers from the Burghers, and financed by a special tax called the Sekban Aqçesi. Typically fighting as infantry armed with muskets, they form the new core of the army, but are perpetually at odds with the Janissaries.

ottoman_malikane_tax_reform.name: Malikâne
ottoman_malikane_tax_reform.desc: A reform to the Muqāta'ah system, Malikâne allows tax farmers to purchase lifelong contracts for tax collection rights in the areas they farm. This provides them with more security and incentivizes long-term investment in their region's overall economic development. The drawback of this system is that maintaining rule of law over these lifetime grants will become more difficult.

ottoman_coffee_house_espionage.name: Coffee House Espionage
ottoman_coffee_house_espionage.desc: Coffee houses and other urban meeting places are major hotspots for subversive activities. By seeding these places with our loyal spies and informants, we can better safeguard state security.

ottoman_new_order_army.name: Niẓām-i Jedīd
ottoman_new_order_army.desc: A radical military reform, the New Order Army relies heavily on foreign instructors and Western tactics and weapons, as well as reorganizing the artillery corps. May it lead us to new victories, and further diminish the troublesome influence of the moribund Janissaries.

legacy_of_osman.name: Legacy of Osman
legacy_of_osman.desc: The Legacy of Osman is a tradition of divine right to expand under the central religious and political authority of our supreme leader. We invoke the Legacy to justify our continued conquests, maintain dynastic legitimacy across diverse holdings, and create an empire where our conquered peoples are not merely subjugated, but fully absorbed. Failure to uphold the Legacy can be seen as a betrayal to our people's traditions.

legacy_of_the_ottomans.name: Legacy of the Ottomans
legacy_of_the_ottomans.desc: After centuries of warfare and triumphant victories, we have finally consolidated vast territories under our banner. The whole of Europe will tremble at the sound of our approach!

leader_of_the_turks.name: Leader of the Turks
leader_of_the_turks.desc: In the midst of chaos lies opportunity. Our leadership over the affairs of Anatolia, as well as our military and financial might, have given us the first say in determining the future of the entire region.

legacy_of_the_turks.name: Legacy of the Turks
legacy_of_the_turks.desc: Besting our powerful neighbors across Anatolia has given way to a new rising power! After centuries of warfare and triumphant victories, we have finally consolidated vast territories under our banner. The whole of Europe will tremble at the sound of our approach!

expanded_posadnichestvo_office.name: Expanded Posadnichestvo
expanded_posadnichestvo_office.desc: The office of the Posadnik is a highly influential position. In order to avoid a one-person power monopoly, the office must be expanded, so that multiple members of the Nobility can assume this position at the same time and keep each other in check.

ruling_commission_of_england.name: Ruling Commission
ruling_commission_of_england.desc: A commission of Nobility has effectively taken over the management of the kingdom, acting as regents. The monarch's ability to exercise power is limited, and their right to rule diminishes over time. The commission can only rule for as long as it retains the support of the parliament, or until such a time that the ruler amasses enough support to overthrow it.

banu_hummay_amendments.name: Banu Hummay Amendments
banu_hummay_amendments.desc: This complex system of succession laws and administrative procedures establishes religious obligations and requires demonstrations of piety from the ruling dynasty.

the_mestnichestvo.name: Mestnichestvo
the_mestnichestvo.desc: The Mestnichestvo is an ancient system that assigns positions of state to people based on the antiquity of their lineage and the seniority they hold within their families. The most tangible demonstration of this system involved the seating order of Boyars at the Tsar's table, which reflects their individual rank and precedence.

kbo_clan_heads_reform.name: Council of Clan Heads
kbo_clan_heads_reform.desc: By seeking advice from the leaders of our most important clans, we can achieve a more stable government, and hopefully bring more prosperity to our society.

manden_kurufa_reform.name: Manden Kurufa
manden_kurufa_reform.desc: The Manden Kurufa, also known as the Manden Federation, is the government of the. Originally started as the 'Twelve Doors' which were the personal possessions of the Mansa, this network of alliances and conquered lands has become the core government of the state.

russian_absolutism.name: Absolutism
russian_absolutism.desc: The obligation to heed the advice of any council has been abolished.

state_controlled_church.name: State-Controlled Church
state_controlled_church.desc: The Church has been fully subjugated to the state.

benevolence_tax_reform.name: Benevolence Tax
benevolence_tax_reform.desc: The Benevolence Tax is a special tax that targets Nobility with ample savings or those living extravagantly, since they can more easily afford larger contributions. It correspondingly reduces the tax burden on the poorest members of society.

navy_board_reform.name: Navy Board
navy_board_reform.desc: The Navy Board is an administrative body responsible for overseeing naval affairs. This centralized institution streamlines fleet management, resulting in more efficient operations and resource allocation.

mlo_council_of_justice.name: Council of Justice
mlo_council_of_justice.desc: Originally an instrument for resolving local disputes between peasants, the Council of Justice has developed into the land's most prominent court, handling cases and operating as a shield for our people.

mlo_secret_council.name: Secret Council
mlo_secret_council.desc: The Secret Council is a body of nobly-born individuals. Its jurisdiction encompasses our entire domain, and often clashes against the ruler's agenda. The majority of critical decisions made by or on behalf of the ruler frequently fall under the Secret Council's review.

four_articles.name: Four Articles
four_articles.desc: A series of demands set forth by our heads of state and faith against the aggressors of the Papal crusades propped up in a weak attempt to suppress our faith.

ned_shipbuilding_industry.name: Dutch Shipbuilding Industry
ned_shipbuilding_industry.desc: With the invention of the fluyte, the Dutch shipbuilding industry has exploded. Domestic and foreign orders are streaming in, and business is booming! Never before have so many Dutch ships sailed the seas, and never before have so many of our people been employed in building them.

geheime_kabinettskanzlei.name: Geheime Kabinettskanzlei
geheime_kabinettskanzlei.desc: Established by the state to clandestinely intercept and examine all correspondence, this Black Chamber will provide us with intelligence about the postal activity within our country. Our agents' expertise in stealthily opening, copying, and resealing official documents will become renowned throughout the world.

libertas_affectandi.name: Libertas Affectandi
libertas_affectandi.desc: Originally granted to the von Babenberg dynasty, which ruled before us, this privilege allows us to select our preferred heir in the case there are none in the direct male line. This will ensure our dynasty retains their possessions even during dire times.

haudenosaunee_clan_mothers.name: Haudenosaunee Clan Mothers
haudenosaunee_clan_mothers.desc: The Clan Mothers of the Haudenosaunee, called Iakoianes, hold the major authority within clans. They are responsible for the internal workings of the tribe and for electing their male counterparts, called Royaner, to represent the clan's interests at the council of all the Haudenosaunee tribes.

andean_monarchy.name: Andean Monarchy
andean_monarchy.desc: A government reform common among the people of the Andes. Spiritual beliefs are woven into the succession laws, forcing new rulers to start their reigns owning no worldly possessions whatsoever.

tawantinsuyu_monarchy.name: Tawantinsuyu Monarchy
tawantinsuyu_monarchy.desc: A government reform of the Incan Empire, adapted and evolved from its monarchic origins. Religious beliefs are inexorably intertwined with succession laws, which leads to new rulers starting their reigns owning nothing.

reformed_tawantinsuyu_government.name: Reformed Tawantinsuyu Government
reformed_tawantinsuyu_government.desc: This reformed government fundamentally restructures Incan governance by eliminating the traditional panaca system, which protected the holdings and possessions of the dead ruler and therefore forced the new Sapa Inca to push for expansion. Instead, it concentrates all power in the hands of the new leader.

grand_remonstrance_reform.name: Grand Remonstrance
grand_remonstrance_reform.desc: The Grand Remonstrance is a series of revisions to the separation of powers. It further restricts the power of the monarchy and prohibits clerical cabinet appointments in exchange for increased parliamentary support and a streamlined bureaucracy.

overhauled_admiralty_reform.name: Overhauled Admiralty
overhauled_admiralty_reform.desc: The Overhauled Admiralty is an attempt to modernize the governing body of the Royal Navy. The reform helps strengthen our naval power while also laying the foundation for the navy's future successes as a formidable maritime entity.

livonian_confederation.name: Livonian Confederation
livonian_confederation.desc: The lands of Baltic have long been disunited, splintered into many different subservient bishoprics and vassals. Instead of trying to unite Terra Mariana into a centralized state, we shall embrace this decentralization.

european_militia_reform.name: Shirley's Militia
european_militia_reform.desc: The Shirley's Militia is an overhaul and retraining of our armed forces, with a focus on modernization and aligning the use of artillery and cavalry in accordance with European practices. This reform strengthens Persia's military power, rivalling that of our enemies.

gabelle.name: Gabelle
gabelle.desc: A government reform permitting a Salt tax, which places great strain on the populace — and plentiful gold in the state coffers.

fra_code_louis.name: Louis Legal Code
fra_code_louis.desc: Following centuries of disparate legal codes across Northern and Southern France, the Code Louis has been established, unifying France under one universal legislative system.

crusade_sea_reform.name: Crusade in the Sea
crusade_sea_reform.desc: As our focus changed from defending castles in the Holy Land to fighting pirates and heathens on the seas, we had to change the way our Order operates. Galleys now will be our battlefields, and our first bulwarks against the enemies of Christ.

catalan_merchant_privileges.name: Catalan Merchant Privileges
mods:
Having a lot of Farfanes units in relation to our total
unit count will give up to +30.0% Global crown estate power
catalan_merchant_privileges.desc: The Catalan merchants of Aragon are active in this country's ports and have received extensive privileges. Part of the duties collected from trading with them is passed onto the mother country, and this state receives the benefit of foreign Christian mercenaries in return.

swe_age_of_freedom.name: Frihetstiden
swe_age_of_freedom.desc: We have entered an Age of Liberty, in which the Crown shall no longer hold absolute sway! The government of Sweden is now in the hands of the estates, and the monarch may do nothing without first gaining our approval.

representative_parliament_reform.name: Representative Parliament
representative_parliament_reform.desc: The introduction of the Representative Parliament marks a significant shift in political dynamics, granting the opportunity for individuals from humble backgrounds, such as Peasants, to secure a seat in Parliament. This privilege has traditionally been the exclusive domain of the elite and privileged classes.

japanese_imperial_family.name: Japanese Imperial Family
japanese_imperial_family.desc: Claiming descent from the sun goddess Amaterasu, the Yamato dynasty has sat upon the Chrysanthemum Throne for centuries.

japanese_clan.name: Japanese Clan
japanese_clan.desc: As a result of the Imperial family's inability to effectively control the countryside, the numerous samurai clans have established their own power bases. The military structure of government under the Shōgun is fertile ground for the constant power struggles between them.

daimyo.name: Daimyō
daimyo.desc: Having ultimate authority over their clan territory, Japanese Daimyō are powerful feudal lords, able to recruit their own armies and collect their own taxes. The most influential of them can even show defiance to the central authority of the Shōgun.

shogunate.name: Shogunate
mods: Cost of Appease the Elites Action
shogunate.desc: As the military government of Japan, the authority of the Shōgun extends to every clan. At least, to those not bold enough to defy it...

shogunate_kanrei_council.name: Kanrei Council
shogunate_kanrei_council.desc: Seeking to form a more cohesive relationship between the Shōgun and Shugo Daimyō of Japan, a council of the many Kanrei allows Shugo Daimyō council members to advise the Shōgun while also engaging with other Shugo Daimyō council members. The senior members of the council are also tasked with handling the affairs of other, weaker clans in the council.

jap_rangaku.name: Rangaku
jap_rangaku.desc: We have encouraged the study of Western matters. While some fear it is detrimental to our societal cohesion, others argue that lessons to be learned from the West are so valuable that we could not afford to do otherwise.

legacy_of_kublai_khan.name: Legacy of Kublai Khan
legacy_of_kublai_khan.desc: Kublai Khan was the one who solidified our rule over China. He adopted the style of the Chinese and proclaimed himself Huángdì of the Middle Kingdom. As long as we follow in his footsteps, our authority over the Dragon Throne will be recognized.

three_departments_system.name: Three Departments
mods: Improves Six Boards bureaucracy positive effect by 50%
three_departments_system.desc: The Three Departments and Six Ministries System originate from ancient Chinese empires, and are the primary administrative structures of our state. Every department is responsible for several aspects of drafting, establishing, and revisiting state policies. The Six Boards are the six major executive bodies of the state, split in the respective affairs of state matters: employment, taxation, rites, military affairs, law enforcement, and public works.

single_whip_law.name: Single Whip Law
single_whip_law.desc: In order to increase taxation efficiency, let us simplify all our different tax regimes into one: All payments to the government shall be made with Silver, and Silver only.

samsa_system.name: Samsa System
samsa_system.desc: Also known as the Three Offices, the Samsa is a collective term for the three major government offices of our state. Composed of members chosen for meritocratic and academic accomplishments, Samsa System ensures checks and balances on the ruler and officials alike.

kor_daedongbeob.name: Daedongbeob
kor_daedongbeob.desc: Also known as Uniform Land Tax Law, Daedongbeob changes the tax regime to be based on uniform Wheat contributions. This set of reforms should improve the lives of the Commoners and increase the commercial potential of our Burghers.

son_in_law_rule.name: 'Son in Law' Rule
mods: Can Only Marry Overlord Dynasty Members
Maximum Tax for Noble Estate (Has upgraded the 'Son in Law' Rule via the Strengthened Ties to the Mongols event.)
Loyalty to Overlord (Has upgraded the 'Son in Law' Rule via the Strengthened Ties to the Mongols event.)
Legislative Efficiency (Has NOT upgraded the 'Son in Law' Rule via the Strengthened Ties to the Mongols event.)
Monthly Diplomats (Has NOT upgraded the 'Son in Law' Rule via the Strengthened Ties to the Mongols event.)
Nobles Power (Has NOT upgraded the 'Son in Law' Rule via the Strengthened Ties to the Mongols event.)
son_in_law_rule.desc: Our state is deeply connected with the dynastic affairs of the Mongol-ruled lands of China. The very core of our current government serves as the extension of the will of Yuán, our 'Father in Law', and our monarchs are obligated to marry Mongol princesses.

kor_sadae_reform.name: Sadae Policy
kor_sadae_reform.desc: Sadae Policy maintains a close relationship between Korea and China, where the former is treated as a junior partner of the latter. With this, we remain subservient to the, and must strive to maintain good relations with the Chinese.

haixi_jurchen_reform.name: Haixi Jurchen
haixi_jurchen_reform.desc: The Haixi Jurchen are a group of Jurchen people who are primarily focused on pastoralism rather than agriculture, which differentiates them from Jianzhou Jurchen. They are also known for their adoption of many Mongolian traditions.

jianzhou_jurchen_reform.name: Jianzhou Jurchen
jianzhou_jurchen_reform.desc: Being a Jianzhou Jurchen means being a highly Sinicized Jurchen group, highly agricultural and permanently settled. These Jurchen peoples have intensive trading networks with nearby Chinese cities.

yeren_jurchen_reform.name: Yeren Jurchen
yeren_jurchen_reform.desc: Yeren Jurchen refers to Jurchen groups who occupy less-settled regions and maintain more traditional ways of life. They rely primarily on hunting and foraging, with less intensive agricultural practice.

prikazi_reform.name: Prikazi
prikazi_reform.desc: The Prikazi is an overhaul of the administrative structure used for government bureaucracy. It establishes several bureaus that are responsible for various aspects of governance, such as taxation, justice, military affairs, and trade, which facilitates more rapid implementation of the policies and decisions made by the Tsar.

razriadnyi_reform.name: Razriadnyi Prikaz
razriadnyi_reform.desc: The Razriadnyi Prikaz introduces a census, which is used to maintain records of the country's population, property, and taxation. It is updated at regular intervals, assesses the military obligations of the estates, and maintains a record of land and property ownership, ensuring that what is due is paid.

byzantine_court_ceremonies_reform.name: Court Ceremonies
byzantine_court_ceremonies_reform.desc: The introduction of the Court Ceremonies ensures grand ceremonies are carried out in accordance with traditions. Meticulous court etiquette is upheld, thereby elevating the prestige and splendor of the ruling elite.

katepanata.name: Katepanáta
mods: Speed of Integration (We have completed the Fate of the Phoenix disaster victoriously)
katepanata.desc: The answer to warmongering neighbors is the consolidation of newly conquered territory through resolute military authority. Originating from the word katepánō — the one placed at the top — the Katepanáta stand above the ordinary themes, grouping provinces beneath a single commander invested with both civil and martial power. First employed with prominence in the 10th and 11th centuries, from Italy with its seat at Bari to the volatile frontiers of Armenia under emperors such as Basil II, these great districts ensured that distant and contested lands were not left to fragmented rule. Let these bastions of our willpower serve as a banner against all those who seek to take our crown from us!

mos_maiorum.name: Mōs Maiōrum
mos_maiorum.desc: Rome was never exclusively Greek. Our titles, our laws, and the memory of the Eternal City descend from a Latin tradition older than our current tongue. The Mōs Maiōrum formalizes this heritage: palace offices are reordered around ancient Roman precedent, the court tongue shifts to Latin, and our diplomats find their work cheaper to sustain.

voivode_reform.name: Voivode
voivode_reform.desc: The implementation of the Voivode makes it easier to govern large swaths of land by introducing a military governor who oversees the local administration and defense. An oath of allegiance is sworn directly to the ruler.

chosen_rada_reform.name: Chosen Rada
chosen_rada_reform.desc: The Chosen Rada creates a powerful council loyal to the ruler, with sweeping authority to suppress the power of the elites. The council's influence extends to matters of governance, policy, and decision-making.

council_of_forty.name: Council of Forty
council_of_forty.desc: Also known as the Quarantia, the Council of Forty is the highest constitutional body of the republic. Although the state is represented by a doge, the real power lies in the hands of the council.

council_of_ten.name: Council of Ten
council_of_ten.desc: The Council of Ten is the major governing body of the republic, focused on the election of the Doge as well as checking the power of the patricians. Its broad jurisdictional mandate covers many aspects of the security of Venetian state security, and makes it the de facto ruling institution of the nation.

full_college.name: Full College
full_college.desc: The executive institution which overlooks the daily governance and the duties of the Senate. All issues and agendas to be discussed are prepared in this executive body beforehand.

signoria_of_venice.name: Signoria of Venice
signoria_of_venice.desc: The supreme governmental body of Venice, the Signoria puts great emphasis on collaboration between the Doge and other key positions of the state. The struggle for power between the council and the Doge therefore becomes a thing of the past.

ven_magistrato_alla_sanita.name: Magistrato alla Sanità
ven_magistrato_alla_sanita.desc: No city in Europe has confronted the threat of epidemic with more rigor than Venice, and the permanent Magistrato alla Sanità we have established is the most sophisticated public health institution in the world — staffed by physicians, notaries, and inspectors all bound to report the first signs of contagion to a central authority. When plague appears at our borders, the Magistracy holds the power to quarantine arriving ships in the lagoon for forty days, a measure we call quarantina, and impose penalties on anyone who conceals sickness. This system has spared Venice from catastrophes that have emptied rival cities, and it keeps our workforce, our merchants, and our fleet healthy enough to sustain trade even as disease sweeps across the peninsula.

ven_provveditori_ai_beni_inculti.name: Provveditori ai Beni Inculti
ven_provveditori_ai_beni_inculti.desc: The mainland territories of the terraferma hold agricultural potential that poor drainage, neglect, and feudal indifference have left unrealized — marshes that could be grain fields, river banks that flood each spring and wash away the labor of the season before. We have established the Provveditori ai Beni Inculti with the authority to commission drainage canals, enforce irrigation schemes, and compensate landowners whose cooperation the works require. This systematic land improvement has extended the productive capacity of our wealthiest agricultural regions, giving Venice a food surplus that keeps the city fed even when sea trade is disrupted by war or blockade.

pru_unified_legal_system.name: Unified Legal System
pru_unified_legal_system.desc: We have gone to great lengths to unify our internal legal systems, rooting out abuse and malpractice while creating a professional judiciary.

portuguese_monarchy_reform.name: Monarchy
portuguese_monarchy_reform.desc: Despite its monarchy initially being like those of other Iberian nations, Portugal has developed a slightly different government: more centralized around its monarchs, with better leverage over its estates, and with a keen eye towards reaping the riches of overseas trade.

altepetl.name: Āltepētl
mods: Disallows Taking Land in Peace Treaties
altepetl.desc: An approximation of a city-state, the Āltepētl is divided into smaller administrative districts called calpōlli. Led by a dynastic ruler, it exudes influence to its surrounding domain and conducts diplomacy with nearby Āltepētl as a sovereign entity.

reformed_nahuatl_society.name: Reformed Nahua Society
reformed_nahuatl_society.desc: An innovative series of centralization reforms and legislative frameworks form the basis of our new government. With attention to detail and strong centralized authority, this legal foundation will cement the rise of a powerful nation, adherent to Nahua teachings.

vij_astadiggajas.name: Astadiggajas
vij_astadiggajas.desc: Astadiggajas - Elephants in Eight Directions - is the collective title granted to the Telugu scholars and poets of our court. Their innovations influence our culture's artistic direction, and will lead us into a new golden era of creative and intellectual achievement.

nayankara_system.name: Nayankara System
nayankara_system.desc: In order to better control our holdings and further our military ambitions, we have divided many of our territorial possessions among Nayaks. These Nayaks are expected to administer these lands and to maintain any cities, temples, and settlements within them, as well as to provide the armies we need to defend and expand our kingdom.

mug_mughal_diwan.name: Mughal Diwan
mug_mughal_diwan.desc: If there is one thing our dynasty has learned over the centuries, it is that we must adopt the native ways of conquered peoples and absorb them into our culture. Let us ensure that we learn from those we conquer so that our empire can continue to expand.

tle_support_of_banu_al_wad.name: Bānu 'Abd āl-Wād Investiture
mods: Tribes estate levy size can be scaled up to +100.0% and Monthly legitimacy can be scaled up to +0.20 with the estate satisfaction of Tribes
Global monthly control can scale from -0.5% to +0.5% with the estate satisfaction of Tribes
Disables the Settle Tribesmen cabinet action
Stability Investment (Unlocked with the Throwing Off Our Tribal Roots event)
tle_support_of_banu_al_wad.desc: The ability to rule this state is largely dependent on the support of the Zenati Bānu 'Abd āl-Wād in the environs of Oran. Should our backing amongst those Tribes falter, so will our legitimacy and ability to govern effectively.

tun_strong_familial_governors.name: Hafsid Familial Governor
mods: Enables Familial Governor subject type, creatable via the Assign Familial Governor action
tun_strong_familial_governors.desc: 'Ifrīqiya is in a state of chaos. Multiple members of the Hafsid are vying for power, trying to take control of Tunis and become the one emir to unite them all. Until then, this region will remain torn by conflict and disloyalty.

taluqdar_nobility.name: Taluqdar Nobility
taluqdar_nobility.desc: Taluqdars, or dynastic aristocrats, own extensive land, collect taxes, and play significant roles in our architecture and economy. As landowners with considerable power and influence in the court, the Taluqdars are our equivalent to the high nobility of other regions.

indian_sultanate_reform.name: Indian Sultanate
indian_sultanate_reform.desc: Ruled by a Islam minority, the Sultanates of India have had to evolve and expand the traditional Islam ideas of kingship. While they remain Islamic states, the role of the Dhimmi, which traditionally encompasses Jews and Christians, has been extended to the Dharmic religions.

mhr_ashta_pradhan.name: Ashta Pradhan
mhr_ashta_pradhan.desc: Ashta Pradhan - Modern Council of Ministers - is the system of ministerial delegation used by the Marathi people. The council is tasked with guiding the administration of the state, overviewing matters of the military, finances, diplomacy, and religion alike.

theme_system.name: Decayed Theme System
theme_system.desc: A system of provincial headquarters and armies, spearheaded by a strategos with dual responsibilities to protect the locals and establish authority at the behest of the realm. This system replaced the provincial administration of Diocletian and has served our people ever since. Yet time has worn it thin, it endures still, a relic of ages long past.

modern_imperial_army.name: Modern Imperial Army
modern_imperial_army.desc: The old Decayed Theme System of Byzantium proved faulty, strengthening the authority of governors and generals rather than the ruler. As a result, a new Imperial Army has formed, one where being a soldier is a profession rather than a duty.

kritai_katholikoi.name: Kritai Katholikoi
kritai_katholikoi.desc: The Kritai Katholikoi, colloquially referred to as the Universal Justices of the Romans, have come to represent the pinnacle of legal authority, born from the reforms of Byz Andronikos Ii Palaiologos and initially comprising of twelve judges from both secular and ecclesiastical backgrounds. Later streamlined to a panel of four, this illustrious court holds unparalleled authority with no recourse for appeal.

kritai_katholikoi_reformed.name: Reformed Kritai Katholikoi
mods: Efficiency of Our Cabinet (Fate of the Phoenix is currently active or we completed it victoriously)
kritai_katholikoi_reformed.desc: Although the judiciary system created by Byz Andronikos Ii Palaiologos saw initial success, there were still internal issues, which the judges exploited to pursue their interests. With the reforms of this Supreme Court, existing legal processes have been streamlined while ensuring no corruption between the judges.

speransky_liberalization_reform.name: Speransky Liberalization Reform
speransky_liberalization_reform.desc: The Speransky Liberalization Reform creates new legislative and executive bodies by introducing a series of regional Dumas. To mediate power between the autocrat and the Dumas, the State Council is made possible with the added purpose of examining any proposed laws.

collegium_reform.name: Collegium
collegium_reform.desc: The Collegium is an overhaul of the administrative structure used for government bureaucracy. It establishes several collegiums as government departments, with a systematic separation of responsibilities to avoid possible overlapping of duties. The collegiums are also tasked with case resolutions, with the help of advisory guidelines.

rule_of_the_sejm.name: Rule of the Sejm
mods: Cannot Declare Wars without Casus Belli
rule_of_the_sejm.desc: The undisputed authority across our lands are the Nobility as they channel their influence through the. Their voices shape our politics and may yet determine the fate of our entire country, for better or worse...

joyous_entry_reform.name: Joyous Entry
joyous_entry_reform.desc: The Joyous Entry grants liberties to our Burghers, akin to a Magna Carta for the Low Countries. This document upholds freedoms for the church, towns, and Nobility, emphasizing consent for taxes and commitments to our nation's indivisibility.

frisian_freedom_reform.name: Frisian Freedom
frisian_freedom_reform.desc: The Frisian Freedom represents the indomitability of our people and their rejection of feudalism and serfdom. They choose their representatives among the landowners and rule the land autonomously. Should a leader rise among them, he must respect the freedoms of his people or face the same fate as any other enemy, whether from within or from the outside.

dutch_republic_reform.name: Dutch Republic
dutch_republic_reform.desc: This is a type of republic where the leader, called the Stadtholder, rules for life. Traditionally, the factions supporting this government have fought over how the Stadtholder's power should be structured. Those called the Statists want to make the Stadtholder more like an Primus inter Pares, whereas the Orangists wish to treat the elected leader as some kind of king.

nakaz_reform.name: Nakaz
nakaz_reform.desc: The Nakaz is an overhaul of the legal code concerning equality, justice, and humanitarianism. Heavily influenced by the Enlightenment, it aims to emulate the progressive reforms that are taking place across Europe, whilst simultaneously simplifying the code of law.

court_of_the_star_chamber_reform.name: Court of the Star Chamber
court_of_the_star_chamber_reform.desc: The Court of the Star Chamber handles cases considered too sensitive or complex for regular courts, ranging from perjury to conspiracy. While known for its efficiency, the court faces criticism for potential abuses of power, lack of due process, and being used as a political tool.

holy_imperial_monarchy_reform.name: Holy Imperial Monarchy
holy_imperial_monarchy_reform.desc: The Empire has reached its maximum splendor. As the only legal successor to the Roman Empire, no one can deny our divinely-favored right to rule!

warring_state.name: Warring State
mods: Has Red Turban Rebellions Casus Belli
Speed of Integration (location belongs to the Chinese culture group and owner has succeeded in subduing Goryeo through the Fate of Korea event chain.)
warring_state.desc: A state of the fractured Celestial Empire which rebels against the current Son of Heaven. Administrative issues are delayed in favor for a more aggressive focus on military expansion.

crown_castile_reform.name: Crown of Castile
mods: Clergy Estate Satisfaction Equilibrium (Has emerged victorious in the situation)
Trade Income (Has emerged victorious in the situation)
crown_castile_reform.desc: When the Kingdoms of Castile and León formed a definitive union in 1230, the Crown of Castile was born. Since then, the country has aimed to become the hegemonic power in Iberia, and one of the greatest and most prestigious nations in Europe.

crown_aragon_reform.name: Crown of Aragon
crown_aragon_reform.desc: The Crown of Aragon is a composite realm formed by several kingdoms and a principality, each with their own institutions and laws. As a trade and seafaring-oriented confederation, it represents extraordinary naval power, primed to dominate the Mediterranean with its fleets.

school_of_first_letters_reform.name: School of First Letters
school_of_first_letters_reform.desc: Promoted by religious orders and municipalities, the Schools of First Letters undertake the mission of educating people not only in the basics of catechism, but also of numbers and letters. By supporting these endeavors, our people learn to read and write correctly, becoming more educated in the process.

sons_of_the_oak_reform.name: Sons of the Oak
