sons_of_the_oak_reform.desc: Our realm is a proud product of its founder: Íñigo Iñiguez, nicknamed Arista, or The Oak. Like the awe-inspiring tree that is his namesake, our nation is meant to endure and resist any forces that may threaten its existence.

system_of_councils_reform.name: System of Councils
system_of_councils_reform.desc: As our nation becomes more powerful, we need a way to unify the multiple councils that our rulers rely on. By creating a polysynodial system, we ensure that our realm is efficient by organizing all those councils to work together.

the_jewel_of_alandalus_reform.name: The Jewel of Al-'Andalus
mods: War Score vs other Religion Efficiency
Pop Assimilation Speed (We must have won the Battle for the Strait situation)
the_jewel_of_alandalus_reform.desc: We are the only surviving member of the formerly Muslim realms that populated Al-'Andalus in the past. Huge Muslim empires have risen and fallen throughout Iberia, fragmenting in the process. As one of those fragmented parts, it is our destiny to reunify the people of Iberia under our banner.

colonial_subject.name: Colonial Subject
colonial_subject.desc: We are at the forefront of civilization, and this has created opportunities for our most brave and intrepid citizens to cross the world and settle here, seeking to carve out a new and prosperous life of their own.

austrian_archduchy_reform.name: Archduchy of Austria
austrian_archduchy_reform.desc: We have been granted the Privilegium Maius, which grants us an elevated position among the princes of the Holy Roman Empire. This shows our status and prestige even outside of Imperial lands, and elevates us to a higher position than that of a mere duke.

empower_the_eunuchs.name: Empower the Eunuchs
empower_the_eunuchs.desc: The usefulness of eunuchs cannot be underestimated. They are widely recognized as the most valuable servants, as they can be trusted not to participate in dynastic politics. We shall provide them with better education so that they can fill important government posts.

serene_republic_of_naples.name: Serene Republic of Naples
serene_republic_of_naples.desc: A form of rule inspired by the government, which combines aspects of a monarchy and a republic.

timurid_empire.name: Timurid Empire
timurid_empire.desc: The great ambitions of our founder have carved an empire of unimaginable expanse into the very face of Central Asia. Our bureaucracy therefore focuses heavily on expanding our borders.

por_ordinances.name: Ordinances
por_ordinances.desc: This formalization of the canon, Roman, and country laws will resolve many judicial conflicts and increase the efficiency of the government.

reichshofrat_reform.name: Reichshofrat
reichshofrat_reform.desc: The Reichshofrat serves as the highest legal institution for Austria and Holy Roman Empire both, giving us stronger control over the legal processes of both our direct and imperial subjects.

anatolian_beylik.name: Anatolian Beylik
mods: Unjustified War on Same Religion Penalty
anatolian_beylik.desc: Situated in the turbulent region of Anatolia, we have emerged after the decay of the Sultanate of Rûm, whose borders we once inhabited. Hardened warriors and capable bureaucrats form the solid base of our robust government.

lifan_yuan.name: Lǐfān Yuàn
mods: Max Control (location has a dominant culture which is neither accepted nor belongs to the Chinese or Jurchen culture group.)
Unrest (location has a dominant culture which is neither accepted nor belongs to the Chinese or Jurchen culture group.)
lifan_yuan.desc: The Lǐfān Yuàn is a a department that administers the state's territories and policies in Inner Asia, such as the provinces in Mongolia, Tibet, and Xinjiang. Should the need ever arise, it will also oversee any holdings further inland.

bohemian_commonwealth_reform.name: Commonwealth
bohemian_commonwealth_reform.desc: The Commonwealth represents a reformed constitution of the realm, giving more privileges and freedom to the various nations living within our borders.

mamluk_government.name: Mamlūk Government
mamluk_government.desc: The Sultanate's rule over the vastness of Egypt depends greatly on maintaining a powerful standing army. Its upper class consists of factions of these powerful slave soldiers, who often ascend to the throne themselves, and can be the deciding factor between a long and short reign.

persian_feudal_theocracy.name: Persian Feudal Theocracy
persian_feudal_theocracy.desc: The Šâh is the absolute ruler of Persia, and under the Šâh exists a complex bureaucratic system that keeps the nation structured and balanced. With positions in the government assigned by merit instead of heritage, the system is assured to function to the best benefit of the nation.

divided_persian_aristocracy.name: Divided Persian Aristocracy
divided_persian_aristocracy.desc: The ruling military classes of our state are at odds with each other. Where they once challenged the Šâh directly, they now vie constantly for the ruler's favor instead.

omani_overseas_ambitions_reform.name: Overseas Ambitions
omani_overseas_ambitions_reform.desc: While the concepts of overseas expansion and colonialism have existed since antiquity, we have observed the modern ways of colonialism and have employed them ourselves. This will allow us to adopt their methods of overseas administration and create our own colonial empire.

seven_provinces.name: Seven Provinces
seven_provinces.desc: Instead of uniting all of our lands under our ruler, we have chosen to divide our nation into Seven Provinces, all with their own ambitions, but still serving us.

unified_admiralty_reform.name: Unified Admiralty
unified_admiralty_reform.desc: The admiralty should never be divided. It should serve the country alone. For that reason, we have united the numerous smaller admiralties within our nation.

powerful_vizierships_reform.name: Powerful Vizierships
mods: Monthly Legitimacy (Having no head of the cabinet yields the following)
powerful_vizierships_reform.desc: A set of ministers who supercede the authority of the ruler, these councilors hold a firm grip on power, while the Sultan is but a mere puppet.

songhai_professional_army_reform.name: Songhai Militant Society
songhai_professional_army_reform.desc: Rather than treating every eligible person in the country as a soldier, it is better to formally establish the distinction between a peasant and a full-time warrior. By dividing our realm into military regions, we will permit the governors to raise their own professional armies and serve the ruler.

promissione_ducale_reform.name: Promissione Ducale
promissione_ducale_reform.desc: The Promissione Ducale serves as the formal oath of office and contractual agreement that each newly elected Doge of Venice must swear to uphold.

standardized_relazioni_reform.name: Standardized Relazioni
standardized_relazioni_reform.desc: The 'Relazioni' are the reports our ambassadors send to the government, detailing the political, financial, and social state of the countries they serve in.

autonomous_swiss_cantons_reform.name: Autonomous Swiss Cantons
autonomous_swiss_cantons_reform.desc: The Swiss Cantons retain much of their independent authority even in our unified country, founded on the same ideals as the loose alliance that existed before.

zur_guild_constitution.name: Guild Constitution
zur_guild_constitution.desc: Divided into a Major and Minor Council, twenty-six councilors shall rule over our domain. These will be recruited in equal numbers from the wealthy merchants, our guild craftsmen, and the nobility. This will ensure no faction will be able to achieve majority and rule without the consent of the others.

dan_the_kings_law.name: The King's Law
dan_the_kings_law.desc: The King's Law is an absolutionist constitution of Denmark, formalizing the king's absolute authority. It makes the monarch a supreme ruler with all legislative, executive, and judicial powers concentrated in his hands.

dan_college_of_missions.name: College of Missions
dan_college_of_missions.desc: The College of Missions is the state-funded association established to help with missionary efforts and converting the population to the true faith.

zimbabwe_royal_cattle_control.name: Royal Ownership of Cattle
zimbabwe_royal_cattle_control.desc: The ownership of Livestock gives us much power, and controlling our country's cattle will help entrench our rule.

zmw_council_of_senior_wives.name: Council of Senior Wives
zmw_council_of_senior_wives.desc: This Council will offer us excellent advice, and involve the most skilled wives of our ruling class in the administration of our country.

kilwan_trade_communities.name: Kilwan Trade Communities
kilwan_trade_communities.desc: A series of loose confederations, often led by a governor that strengthens the power of local merchants, these communities push for local autonomy and urbanization. Their trading skills provide a steady stream of revenue for our treasuries.

control_of_the_mahdali_coinage_reform.name: Control of the Mahdali Coinage
control_of_the_mahdali_coinage_reform.desc: The might of our dynasty is imprinted upon the coins that circulate the markets from the Italy coast, to India, and beyond. This trimetallic coin is primarily made of Copper, Silver, and Gold, and is the first of its kind to exert such influence on a multiregional scale. Control of its circulation is synonymous with continued prosperity!

ayu_chatusadom.name: Chatusadom
ayu_chatusadom.desc: Meaning 'Four Pillars', the Chatusadom ministry organization divides the government into two branches: the military, and civil affairs, the latter of which is further divided into four ministries. The compartmentalization and clear assignment of tasks to each makes for a more effective administration and serves as an extension of the ruler's authority.

mandala_system.name: Mandala System
mandala_system.desc: The Mandala is a system of power in which independent city states swear fealty to whoever leads the most powerful state among them. Stemming from the Dharmic and Buddhist worldview, the fundamental idea is that power emanates radially from a center source. Thus, each of the polities is a source of local power, but their power in turn radiates from the central, most powerful, source.

malian_tribute_system.name: Tribute System
malian_tribute_system.desc: Our primary source of Gold, the Tribute System is a system which demands that all Gold is taxed and ultimately controlled by the ruler.

son_trans_saharan_trade.name: Trans-Saharan Trade
son_trans_saharan_trade.desc: The trade routes of Trans-Saharan Africa have always brought wealth to West Africa and its empires. Instead of letting these routes decay, let us offer support to the caravans passing through our lands.

eth_wandering_court.name: Local Audiences
eth_wandering_court.desc: Rather than having a stationary court, we prefer the freedom to move at will to other parts of the nation. With our reliance on a Itinerant Court, we can more easily re-adjust where our rulers govern from, and better address the issues of local populations.

maghrebi_administration.name: Maghrebi Administration
maghrebi_administration.desc: The Maghrebi makhzan — the royal household administration of the Hafsids, Zayyanids, Marinids, and their successors — projects central authority through walis at the area level and qā'ids at the city level, all answerable to the sultan's chamber. These appointed officials collect taxes, dispense justice, and command levies under the dīwān's supervision, replacing the older tribal hierarchies wherever the state can sustain the apparatus. This bureaucratic infrastructure gives the Maghrebi monarchies a level of central direction that purely tribal confederations elsewhere in our region have never reproduced.

shurfa_status.name: Shurfā' Status
shurfa_status.desc: Our sultans claim descent from the Prophet Muhammad through the Idrisid line of the eighth century, and the Saadi and Alaouite dynasties have institutionalized this lineage as the central legitimacy of the Moroccan throne. The shurfā' — accredited descendants of the Prophet — hold a recognized rank above all other social classes, with their own marriage registers, tax exemptions, and judicial standing supervised by the royal naqīb. This sacralization of the dynasty gives the Moroccan sultan a religious authority that no other Maghrebi ruler can claim and that no rebel can credibly challenge.

guardians_of_ifriqiya.name: Guardians of Ifrīqya
guardians_of_ifriqiya.desc: Tunis carries the dynastic memory of Carthage's Punic dominion, Kairouan's Aghlabid amirate, and the Hafsid claim to the title of Khalīfa — caliph of the western Islamic world after the fall of Baghdad. Our sultans crown themselves in the Zaytuna mosque under regalia that links their throne to a thousand-year continuity of Ifrīqyan sovereignty, distinct from any Berber dynasty to the west or Mamluk power to the east. This composite imperial legacy gives Tunis a legitimacy that the surrounding Maghrebi states cannot match in either antiquity or doctrinal weight.

bng_industralized_provinces.name: Rapid Industralization
bng_industralized_provinces.desc: Unlike other nations, we have doubled our efforts towards urbanization and a production-based economy. While this has had the desired beneficial effect on economic matters, much of the peasantry is left worried by such a massive cultural shift.

hab_geheimer_rat.name: Geheimer Rat
hab_geheimer_rat.desc: The Geheimer Rat serves as a central advisory body to the monarch. Comprised of high-ranking nobles, ministers, and confidants, the council played a crucial role in shaping Imperial policies.

tughlaq_slave_army_reform.name: Tughlaq Slave Army
tughlaq_slave_army_reform.desc: Due to a national surplus of slaves, we can use them to serve as an imperial guard. That way, we shall have a disciplined force on the battlefield while also ensuring the safety of the court.

diwan_i_bandagan.name: Diwan-i Bandagan
diwan_i_bandagan.desc: The number of slaves procured by the state has grown so massive that a special department — Diwan-i Bandagan, the Department of Slaves — has been created to manage them and their operations.

shahana_i_mandi.name: Sahana-i-Mandi
shahana_i_mandi.desc: By placing market regulations on religious minorities, we can justify lower salaries for our armies, while also ensuring that any heretic or heathen remains in subjugation.

the_protectorate.name: Protectorate
the_protectorate.desc: Emphasizing the values of military might and strong centralized power under the guidance of a Lord Protector, the Protectorate is a new style of government enforced after the victory of the Parliamentarians during the The English Civil War.

timurid_diwan_reform.name: Timurid Dīwān
timurid_diwan_reform.desc: We should abandon other forms of rule and legalize the Sharī'ah as the official law. This Timurid Dīwān will allow us to establish proper Islamic rule over any non-believers, as well as making it easier to grant governorship to our relatives.

soyurghal_governor_reform.name: Tutorship Soyurghal Governor
soyurghal_governor_reform.desc: Governors of the who were appointed to the position because they either needed more experience before becoming the next ruler, because the area in question desperately needed a capable governor, or simply to exclude them from the active politics of the realm.

soyurghal_governor_banished_reform.name: Banished Soyurghal Governor
soyurghal_governor_banished_reform.desc: Governors of the who were appointed to the position because they either needed more experience before becoming the next ruler, because the area in question desperately needed a capable governor, or simply to exclude them from the active politics of the realm.

soyurghal_governor_effective_governor_re.name: Soyurghal Governor
soyurghal_governor_effective_governor_re.desc: Governors of the who were appointed to the position because they either needed more experience before becoming the next ruler, because the area in question desperately needed a capable governor, or simply to exclude them from the active politics of the realm.

subah_organization_reform.name: Sūbah Organization
subah_organization_reform.desc: By strategically placing numerous governors within our realms, we can easily control every corner of our nation without having to worry about losing our grasp on them. It also allows us to urbanize areas more easily.

uc_bey_reform.name: Uç Bey Government
uc_bey_reform.desc: A militaristic government responsible for maintaining an army with which to secure the domain and borders of its overlord.

volok_reform.name: Valakų Reform
volok_reform.desc: With the Valakų Reform, our Nobility are more regulated in their behavior towards our subjects. This supports the Commoners within our realm, while also solidifying their status as an independent estate.

lit_grand_duchy_of_lithuania_reform.name: Supreme Dukedom
lit_grand_duchy_of_lithuania_reform.desc: Rather than styling ourselves as the equal of other dukes, we instead choose to be elevated to a status that better expresses our strength.

cossacks_reform.name: Sich Rada
cossacks_reform.desc: Wishing to further organize the Cossacks under one ruler, the Sich Rada places a Hetman in charge to lead them all, serving either their own interests or the interests of their liege.

bank_of_england_reform.name: Bank of England
bank_of_england_reform.desc: A centralized and influential institution, this bank is made up of powerful financiers and greatly increases our credibility and capacity to handle our debts. Its purpose is to handle public finances, helping to stabilize government borrowing.

chi_peasant_empire_reform.name: Mandate of the Commons
chi_peasant_empire_reform.desc: Many Chinese dynasties have been founded with the support of the Commoners. However, only ours has fully recognized the importance of the common people. No other era in the history of the has ever seen such popular support!

royal_council_of_castile.name: Royal Council of Castile
royal_council_of_castile.desc: The Royal Council of Castile is a centralized royal council to streamline taxation, justice, and administration under the direct oversight of the Crown.

nueva_planta.name: Nueva Planta
nueva_planta.desc: The Nueva Planta is a series of decrees and reforms formalized in order to abolish regional legal privileges and forge a single, unitary state under central authority.

royal_factories_reform.name: Royal Factories
royal_factories_reform.desc: Royal Factories are state-funded manufactories directly overseen by the Crown to produce strategic and luxury goods in support of mercantilist and centralized economic policies.

intendancy_system.name: Intendancy System
intendancy_system.desc: The Intendancy System is a new system of governance aimed at centralizing the authority of the Crown over that of the bureaucrats in order to oversee tax collection and implement anti-corruption measures.

mll_pearl_of_the_mediterranean.name: Pearl of the Mediterranean
mods: Number of Naval Governors (If our capital is in Balearics)
Maritime Presence % (If our capital is in Balearics)
mll_pearl_of_the_mediterranean.desc: Following careful maneuvering of past rulers, the Balearics have become one of the most important regions of trade throughout the Mediterranean Sea, with many merchants choosing the islands as a core stop.

iro_reforged_law_of_peace.name: Great Law of Peace
iro_reforged_law_of_peace.desc: Enshrined through Wampum belts, the framework for the Great Law of Peace has governed our Confederacy since its inception. Emphasizing peace and justice, along with maintaining a steady mind, the principles of the Great Law of Peace have united all within the Haudenosaunee nation.

iro_council_of_the_fifty.name: The Grand Council
iro_council_of_the_fifty.desc: Comprised of fifty chiefs from each of the Five Nations, the Haudenosaunee Grand Council carries out the principles of the Great Law of Peace. The council's governance requires all fifty chiefs to reach a unified consensus before affairs can continue.

peuplierung_system.name: Peuplierung System
peuplierung_system.desc: The Peuplierung System is an initiative that aims to attract immigrants to settle in the sparsely populated regions of the nation.

guru_granth_sahib_reform.name: Guru Granth Sahib
guru_granth_sahib_reform.desc: Regarded as the eternal Gurū by Sikhism, it was compiled and expanded by several Gurū across the ages, and it contains all teaching to guide the Sikh faithful.

alsno_stadga.name: Alsnö Stadga
alsno_stadga.desc: This set of rules was set up by Swe Magnus Ladulas in 1280 at Alsnö Hus to regulate and formalize the benefits of the Nobility, while also protecting the Peasants from their exploits. This is why he was nicknamed 'Ladulås', or 'Barn-Lock' in English by the commoners.

shahbandariyya_reform.name: Shāhbandariyya
shahbandariyya_reform.desc: To manage the vast tide of merchants arriving at our ports, we appoint a Shāhbandar as the authority to oversee customs, resolve disputes, and organize the foreign quarters. This office brings order to our bustling entrepôt and will strengthen our role as the crossroads of the seas.

partitio_reform.name: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae
partitio_reform.desc: After the Fourth Crusade, the Eastern Roman Empire was partitioned among several Western European families, who then founded a series of Crusader Principalities. While these polities existed, they were a constant threat to the Empire.

ach_heirs_of_the_latin_empire.name: Titular Rulers of the Latin Empire
mods: Can Create Latin Reconquest casus belli
ach_heirs_of_the_latin_empire.desc: Although we have since lost control of Constantinople, the seat of power for the, our claim to it still remains as strong as ever.

ath_rule_of_the_catalans.name: Dominance of the Catalan Company
ath_rule_of_the_catalans.desc: Since the seizure of the, the Catalan Company has projected considerable military influence over Greece.

lat_papal_restoration_claimant.name: Backing to Retake Constantinople
mods: Can Create Latin Reconquest casus belli
lat_papal_restoration_claimant.desc: Although the has since been destroyed by the, recent crusader state campaigns in Greece have encouraged sponsorship to restore the empire.

lat_restored_rule_of_the_latins.name: Restored Rule of the Latins
mods: Can Create Latin Reconquest casus belli
lat_restored_rule_of_the_latins.desc: Once thought to be lost forever to a resurgent Byzantium, the has at long last been restored in Constantinople, and once against serves as a bastion of Catholic rule throughout Greece.

luc_libertas.name: Libertas!
luc_libertas.desc: The common people should not wait until foreign powers come and take away their homes, families, and futures. Instead, every citizen must be ready to give up their lives for a brighter future.

jewish_nagid_reform.name: The Nagid
jewish_nagid_reform.desc: The office of the Nāgīd — the Prince of the community — establishes a recognized head of the Jewish nation, charged with both civil authority and religious stewardship. Drawing on centuries of communal self-governance under foreign sovereigns, the Nāgīd channels our people's resilience into diplomatic presence and spiritual renewal.

jewish_exilarchate_reform.name: The Exilarchate
jewish_exilarchate_reform.desc: The Exilarch, or Rosh Galuta, is the hereditary prince of all Jews in exile, claiming unbroken descent from the House of David. The office commands unrivaled reverence among our people, lending the state the sacred legitimacy of a continuous royal lineage stretching back to the kings of Israel.

jewish_sanhedrin_republic_reform.name: The Sanhedrin Republic
jewish_sanhedrin_republic_reform.desc: In the tradition of the ancient council of seventy-one sages, the Sanhedrin is restored as the supreme deliberative body of the Jewish state. Its learned scholars and jurists govern through debate, precedent, and the deep study of law — a republic of wisdom rather than of swords.

jewish_kehilla_federation_reform.name: The Kehilla Federation
jewish_kehilla_federation_reform.desc: The Kehilla — the self-governing Jewish community — is elevated to the organizing principle of the state. Each city's council manages its own affairs, pooling merchant expertise and communal networks into a decentralized federation bound by shared law, language, and commerce.

jewish_messianic_monarchy_reform.name: The Messianic Monarchy
jewish_messianic_monarchy_reform.desc: This is no ordinary kingdom: the ruler is proclaimed the anointed of God, the long-awaited Mashiaḥ, whose reign heralds the redemption of Israel and the ingathering of all exiles. Such a claim commands absolute devotion from our people, but no foreign power may be expected to recognize it, and the world watches with suspicion and unease.

manila_galleon_reform.name: The Manila Galleon
manila_galleon_reform.desc: By reserving this trade exclusively for Crown-appointed merchants, we can ensure that the wealth flowing across the Pacific strengthens royal finances rather than enriching private interests.

maghreb_ibadi_majlis_ammi_said.name: Centralized Majlis 'Ammi Sa'īd
maghreb_ibadi_majlis_ammi_said.desc: Founded in the wake of the fall of the Ibadi Rustamids, the Majlis 'Ammi Sa'īd council has served as a decentralized form of federal governance for the remnant states within the Mzab Valley. However, with the rise of a new Ibadi state in the Maghreb, the once-decentralized council has now been reshaped into a core part of the bureaucracy.

gra_hajib_reform.name: Ḥājib ad-Dawla
gra_hajib_reform.desc: The office of Ḥājib — chamberlain and chief minister — is the pivot around which the administration of our Emirate turns. The Ḥājib coordinates the royal household, oversees the financial administration of the dīwān, and acts as the principal intermediary between the sultan and the bureaucratic machinery of the state. By formalizing and empowering this office, we concentrate the day-to-day work of governance in the hands of a single capable administrator, freeing the sultan for the demands of war and diplomacy while ensuring the smooth functioning of the realm.

mor_sharifian_sultanate_reform.name: Sharifian Sultanate
mor_sharifian_sultanate_reform.desc: The Sharifian sultans have transformed Morocco from a confederation beholden to its tribal levies into a centralized monarchy whose authority flows from both genealogical sanctity and military discipline. The jīš service-tribes settle on crown land, Andalusi gunners drill on Fez's artillery range, and the great maḵzan apparatus moves tax rolls and judicial writs across the realm with a regularity the Marinids never achieved. This is the state-form that turns our baraka — the sacred charisma of descent from the Prophet — from a legitimacy claim into a governing system: a sultanate that is simultaneously a dynasty, a bureaucracy, and a religious court.

cas_santa_hermandad_reform.name: Santa Hermandad
mods: Allows us to raise Hermandad Infantry
Unlocks the Summon the Santa Hermandad cabinet action
cas_santa_hermandad_reform.desc: The Santa Hermandad is a permanent royal constabulary charged with policing the roads and suppressing brigandry across our realm. Founded by the joint authority of Fernando and Isabel, it replaces the old municipal brotherhoods with a centralized force answerable to the Crown. The Hermandad ensures that the safety of travel and commerce extends into the countryside, bringing the reach of royal justice far beyond the city walls.

ara_diputacion_general_reform.name: Diputación General de Aragón
ara_diputacion_general_reform.desc: The Diputació General d'Aragó began as a standing committee of the Cortes of Aragon tasked with overseeing the collection of subsidies granted to the Crown, and has since grown into a permanent institution of government. Administered by elected Diputados drawn from the three Estates, it ensures fiscal accountability and guards the constitutional fueros against royal encroachment. The Diputación meets year-round, transforming what was once an occasional assembly into a continuous organ of Aragonese self-governance.

cat_corts_catalanes_reform.name: Corts Catalanes
cat_corts_catalanes_reform.desc: The Corts Catalanes are one of the oldest representative assemblies in Europe, organized in three arms — the clergy, the nobility, and the braç reial representing the royal towns. No extraordinary taxation may be levied without the consent of all three arms, and the Crown must address the assembly's grievances before any subsidy is granted. This three-arm constitution defines the Catalan polity as a pact between ruler and ruled, where sovereignty rests not in the monarch alone but in the organic whole of the realm.

cat_generalitat_reform.name: Generalitat de Catalunya
cat_generalitat_reform.desc: The Generalitat de Catalunya was established as the permanent standing committee of the Catalan Corts, entrusted with administering subsidies and governing between sessions of the full assembly. Over time it has become the institutional embodiment of Catalan constitutional liberties, a continuous body of elected representatives who hold the Crown to its sworn obligations. The Generalitat's permanence transforms Catalan parliamentary tradition from an occasional assembly into the daily reality of governance.

mll_universitat_de_mallorca_reform.name: Universitat de Mallorca
mll_universitat_de_mallorca_reform.desc: The Universitat de la Ciutat i Regne de Mallorca is the governing body of our island realm, administered by elected Jurats who oversee taxation, public works, and the interests of the burgher and merchant communities. Its long tradition of municipal self-governance has made the mercantile class the dominant force in Mallorcan affairs, ensuring that trade policy and port administration reflect the needs of those who profit from the sea. The Universitat's competent civic administration is the backbone of Mallorcan prosperity.

por_estado_da_india_reform.name: Estado da Índia
por_estado_da_india_reform.desc: The Estado da Índia is the formal administrative framework through which Portugal governs its far-flung network of trading posts, fortresses, and colonies across Asia. Administered from the viceregal seat of Goa, it coordinates the fleets, garrisons, and revenue of a maritime empire spanning from the Persian Gulf to the South China Sea. By centralizing colonial governance under a single viceregal authority, the Estado allows the Crown to extract revenue and project power far beyond what any private trading venture alone could sustain.

glc_xunta_xeral_reform.name: Xunta Xeral do Reino de Galicia
glc_xunta_xeral_reform.desc: The Xunta Xeral do Reino de Galicia is the representative assembly of our kingdom, convening delegates from the seven provinces of Galicia to deliberate on taxation, justice, and the defense of regional rights. As a permanent institution, it gives the Galician nobility, clergy, and towns a formal channel through which to negotiate with the Crown and safeguard the particular customs of this corner of Iberia. The Xunta's enduring authority has made Galicia one of the better-governed peripheries of the peninsula.

lon_cortes_de_leon_reform.name: Cortes de León
lon_cortes_de_leon_reform.desc: The Cortes de León — first convened in 1188 under Alfonso IX — are among the oldest representative assemblies in European history, predating the English Parliament by nearly a century. Drawing together the clergy, the nobility, and representatives of the towns, they established the principle that the monarch must seek the counsel of all estates before imposing new obligations. This founding constitutional tradition gives our governance a legitimacy rooted not in conquest alone but in the formal consent of the realm.

nav_cortes_navarra_reform.name: Cortes de Navarra
nav_cortes_navarra_reform.desc: The Cortes of Navarre convene the three estates of the kingdom — clergy, nobility, and the towns — in a body whose consent is required for any extraordinary taxation or major legislation. Older than most Iberian parliaments, the Navarrese Cortes have jealously guarded the traditional liberties of the realm and maintained the particular law codes that distinguish Navarre from its larger neighbors. By institutionalizing this assembly, we formally acknowledge that the authority of the Crown flows through and with the consent of the estates.

basque_juntas_generales_reform.name: Juntas Generales
basque_juntas_generales_reform.desc: The Juntas Generales are the traditional representative assemblies of the Basque provinces, meeting beneath the ancient oak of Gernika to deliberate on law, taxation, and the defense of local rights. Each province maintains its own fuero, a body of customary law that any overlord must swear to uphold before their authority is recognized. The Juntas represent a form of decentralized self-governance unique in Iberia, one that no centralizing Crown has managed to abolish without provoking fierce resistance.

anr_coprincipality_reform.name: Co-Principality Structure
anr_coprincipality_reform.desc: The land of Andorra is governed under a unique constitutional arrangement: the joint sovereignty of two co-princes, the Bishop of Urgell and the Count of Foix, whose competing claims have paradoxically produced a stable equilibrium. Neither sovereign can act without the consent of the other, and this mutual check has preserved Andorra from absorption by either neighbor. We have formalized this co-principality structure as the constitutional foundation of our realm, accepting the limitations it places on unilateral action in exchange for the diplomatic shelter it provides.

agraw_federation_reform.name: Agraw Federation
agraw_federation_reform.desc: The agraw — the village-and-clan deliberative assembly of the Kabyle highlands — governs without a central executive: decisions taken in council bind all participating clans, and no single office can override the combined voice of the assembled elders. This federal structure makes us nearly impervious to the standard method of conquest — there is no throne to capture, no palace to burn, and no single treaty to repudiate — and it brings the villages into one administrative unit without imposing on them the apparatus of a distant sultan. We accept slower deliberation as the price of genuine self-governance, and find that our people, left to their own assemblies, have little reason to revolt against them.

alg_dey_regency_reform.name: Regency of Algiers
alg_dey_regency_reform.desc: The Regency of Algiers has evolved a distinctive governmental form: a dey elected by the military's janissary corps, an aga commanding the land forces, and a divan of senior officers who together constitute both the cabinet and the parliament of the state. This is not a dynasty — the dey answers to the corps that made him, and a dey who loses the confidence of the odjak rarely lasts out the season — but it is a stable system of its kind, producing an administratively capable corsair-military state that punches well above its population in naval and commercial projection. We have codified this arrangement as the constitutional form of the Regency, accepting the instability of military succession in exchange for an army that governs itself and a treasury fed by the sea.

amenokal_paramountcy_reform.name: Amenokal Paramountcy
amenokal_paramountcy_reform.desc: The amenokal — paramount chief of the Tuareg confederation — rules not through a bureaucracy but through the personal authority of his title, the drum-of-office regalia, and the loyalty of the noble imashaghen caste who enforce his will across the dispersed clans. His power is simultaneously personal and confederal: real enough to mobilize the mounts and spears of every confederation member, diffuse enough to project across hundreds of leagues of desert without a garrison to hold each oasis. We have codified this paramount structure as our governmental form, concentrating diplomatic and military coordination in the amenokal's person while leaving the daily governance of each clan to its own customs.

diwan_of_the_azzaba_reform.name: Dīwān al-'Azzāba
diwan_of_the_azzaba_reform.desc: The Dīwān al-'Azzāba — the council of Ibadi religious scholars who serve simultaneously as jurists, arbiters, and governors — is the unique political form of the Mzab pentapolis, and the closest approximation to the original Ibadi ideal of a community governed by the most learned rather than the most powerful. State and faith are not separated here: the 'Azzāba hold court in the mosque, pronounce on commercial disputes under the same doctrinal framework as theological questions, and legitimate authority requires the consent of this clerical council before it can act. We embrace this austerity as a constitutional principle: our realm will be governed not as kingdoms are governed, but as a community of believers accountable to God and to one another.

mor_marinid_zenata_confederation_reform.name: Marinid Zenata Confederation
mor_marinid_zenata_confederation_reform.desc: The Banū Marīn rode out of Figuig as Zenati horse-lords and took Fez from the failing Almohad dynasty by tribal cohesion and a banner of Mālikī orthodoxy. Our Marinid dynasty still stands on both pillars: the Zenati clans ride when our summons them, the fuqahā' bless rule, and the jihād in al-'Andalus answers to each. A Marinid commands because tribesmen follow and scholars sanction, and must keep proving both with the sword.

ribat_state_tradition_reform.name: Ribaṭ-State Tradition
ribat_state_tradition_reform.desc: The ribaṭ — the fortified-monastery from which the Almoravid movement organized its sweep across the Sahara and up through the Maghreb — is more than a building: it is a model of governance, where the religious-military brotherhood occupies a network of fortresses and mosques from which it administers the surrounding territory through the piety of its garrison rather than the payroll of a civilian bureaucracy. We have inherited this tradition: our polity is governed from fortress nodes rather than from a single palace, our administrators are at the same time warriors and men of religion, and our legitimacy rests on the sustained discipline of the frontier rather than the genealogy of a dynasty. This austerity of governance gives us hard-defended positions, a clergy that fights, and a fighting force that prays.

tun_husaynid_beylik_reform.name: Husaynid Beylik
tun_husaynid_beylik_reform.desc: Where the Ottoman framework installed rotating governors answerable to the Porte, the Husaynid bey transformed the beylik of Tunis into a hereditary dynasty in all but name, negotiating a constitutional fiction — nominal Ottoman sovereignty, effective dynastic rule — that lasted into the modern era. The Husaynids built a capable cabinet-based administration, preserved Ifrīqyan cultural continuity, and managed the balance between the increasingly nominal Ottoman connection and the practical demands of European diplomacy with more sophistication than most comparable polities. We have institutionalized this hybrid: a state that is dynastically governed, administratively modern in its cabinet apparatus, and prestigious enough to deal as a recognized sovereign while retaining the theological cover of Islamic suzerainty.

amir_al_muslimin.name: Amīr al-Muslimīn
mods: Damage Done versus Heathens in Battle
amir_al_muslimin.desc: The title Amīr al-Muslimīn — Commander of the Muslims — was carried by the Almoravid sultans who crossed the Sahara to rescue al-'Andalus from Christian encroachment and by our Marinid forebears who returned across the Strait again and again in the same cause. Winning the Strait from the fleets of Castile and Aragon has placed us in that lineage: protectors of the last western frontier of Islam, recognized in the khuṭba of every mosque from Fez to the Guadalquivir. This title binds the Andalusi communities to our throne, fills our banners with willing warriors of the faith, and carries our name to every Muslim court that watches the Iberian peninsula.

cas_alcabala_tax.name: Alcabala Tax
cas_alcabala_tax.desc: Institutionalizing a permanent royal tax will create a stable source of income for the treasury that is intended to strengthen our finances and fund our future wars.

crown_of_al_andalus.name: The Crown of al-'Andalus
mods: Possible Government Reforms (european dominance is at 100)
crown_of_al_andalus.desc: One crown now binds them all. The ṭā'ifa of Iberia, long sundered since the fall of Córdoba, are gathered beneath a single throne, and faithful and dhimmi alike answer to the authority of our house.

autocracy.name: Autocracy
autocracy.desc: Autocratic monarchies concentrate power in the hands of the ruler. The state is often seen as their personal property. It is not uncommon for rulers to have ministers and supporters, but these are then referred to as members of the royal household.

feudal_nobility.name: Feudal Nobility
feudal_nobility.desc: In a feudal kingdom, the power of the monarch is enhanced by a land-owning aristocracy sworn to obey them. The aristocrats, or Nobility, are often landowners in their own right, with considerable influence and vassals of their own.

margraviate.name: Margraviate
margraviate.desc: A Margraviate is a historical territorial jurisdiction, named after a Markgraf, or 'count on the frontier', who serves to defend and administer the border regions of a realm, mostly focused on repelling external threats. Margraviates blend military defense with governance; the Margrave's responsibilities include safeguarding the frontier and managing local affairs, bridging the gap between the central authority and these border territories.

landgraviate.name: Landgraviate
landgraviate.desc: A Landgraviate, named after a Landgraf, acts as an immediate jurisdiction of the in otherwise fractured counties. The Landgrave is a direct representative of the law of the in the lands of the Landgraviate, and the title is comparable to a Duke in power and responsibilities.

of_noble_bearing.name: Of Noble Bearing
of_noble_bearing.desc: The proud lineage of our nobles, standing far taller on two legs than the rulers of any other nation on Earth, should be evident to all!

judicate_reform.name: Judicate
judicate_reform.desc: The Judicate is a unique type of government which is defined by its republic-like institutions, and by electing the ruler from within the Supreme Court.

the_court_of_wards_and_liveries.name: The Court of Wards and Liveries
the_court_of_wards_and_liveries.desc: With a court of wards and liveries, the administration of tax collection and feudal dues is much more effective, due to increased expertise among collectors and a systemized revenue system. However, the nobility tend to consider such courts deeply exploitative of their own fortunes.

royal_decree.name: Royal Decree
royal_decree.desc: The monarch rules supreme in this country, and loyalty is valued above all else. We must ensure that decrees from the royal court are followed to the letter, and in all parts of our country.

privy_council.name: Privy Council
privy_council.desc: Staying informed about events within one's domain is vital for any ruler. By establishing a privy council, we will be able to keep a much closer eye on our people.

royal_commission_act.name: Royal Commissions
royal_commission_act.desc: Investigating suspicious behavior within the administration might be a good idea from time to time. Creating more royal commissions will certainly help to reduce corruption.

revolutionary_empire.name: Revolutionary Empire
revolutionary_empire.desc: The Revolutionary Empire is a Monarchy which makes some concessions to the ideas of the Enlightenment, while ruling over the people with absolute power under the pretext of serving revolutionary ideals.

feudal_theocracy.name: Feudal Theocracy
feudal_theocracy.desc: A Feudal Theocracy is a state ruled by a religious figurehead. Unlike other theocracies, it is governed in a more hereditary manner, allowing its rulers to pass the leadership to members of their families.

noble_elite.name: Noble Elite
noble_elite.desc: In this republic, the right to rule is hereditary within certain noble dynasties. These families elect the ruler from within their dynasty, and this head of government will in turn depend on their support.

sortition.name: Sortition
sortition.desc: Unfortunately, votes can be bought, and old loyalties may cloud the judgment of some electors. Let us implement a semi-randomized system where names can be chosen from a pool of good candidates for important offices.

merchant_republic.name: Merchant Republic
mods: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language
merchant_republic.desc: A republic founded upon the principles of trade. The flow of commerce is the most important factor for the families who rule these republics.

peasant_republic_reform.name: Peasant Republic
mods: Prefers Court Language to be Common Language
peasant_republic_reform.desc: A form of government in which the Crown, Nobility, and Clergy are very weak or non-existent, granting a high degree of autonomy to the Commoners.

pirate_brethren_reform.name: Pirate Brethren
mods: Prefers Court Language to be Common Language
pirate_brethren_reform.desc: Insofar as this loose collection of pirate crews can be called a state, the Pirate Brethren is a haven for all manner of thieves, murderers, and smugglers.

formalized_measures.name: Formalized Scales, Weights, and Measures
formalized_measures.desc: Our nation has formalized its system of scales, weights, and measures. While it is not universal, the new system does ensure our people use the same basic units of measurement everywhere in the country. Now, there are four bovates to a hide. Or possibly eight. And then five hides equal a fee... er, or do they?

dynastic_signoria_reform.name: Dynastic Signoria
dynastic_signoria_reform.desc: Individual city-states ruled by powerful families, the Dynastic Signoria involves a concentration of power in a small group of influential individuals known as the signori. These individuals, some who were of merchant or banking origins rather than traditional nobility, hold both executive and legislative authority, effectively monopolizing control over their respective cities. They aim to maintain their power at all costs, often resulting in bloody feuds and conflicts between and within houses as they struggle for supremacy.

signoria_reform.name: Signoria
signoria_reform.desc: A specific Italian form of city republican government. Members are elected for a specific period of time, usually from among the most influential citizens of that city. However, in many cases they are also foreign rulers who are invited to rule the Signoria.

revolutionary_republic.name: Revolutionary Republic
revolutionary_republic.desc: The Revolutionary Republic governs the nation through a small executive authority, supported by an elective chamber of deputies. Revolutionary propaganda will strengthen the resolve of our armies, and the principal of universal equality should inspire strong and confident leadership.

revolutionary_autocracy.name: Revolutionary Autocracy
revolutionary_autocracy.desc: While on the surface a Republic, the Revolutionary Autocracy is akin to an absolute Military Dictatorship led by a competent general or admiral who enjoys great popularity amongst the masses.

hanseatic_merchant_federation.name: Hanseatic Merchant Federation
mods: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language
hanseatic_merchant_federation.desc: This represents a decentralized federation of merchants united under one alliance. Its members occupy special buildings across the entirety of Europe and are known for their mercantile prowess.

legacy_of_genghis.name: Legacy of Genghis Khān
legacy_of_genghis.desc: We are the descendants of the great conqueror of the world, Genghis Khān. His blood runs through our veins, making us a proud and powerful people, and promising us that everywhere our horses can take us shall be ours to conquer!

military_order_reform.name: Military Order
mods: May be Target of Military Sponsorships
military_order_reform.desc: The Military Orders were created in the Middle Ages as a militant body of the Catholic Church. They are made up of warriors, named miles, as well as monks called fratres who have taken solemn religious vows to defend and spread the Christian faith.

abbey_reform.name: Abbey
abbey_reform.desc: Abbeys have been centers of monastic life since the earliest Christian times. Over the centuries, they have become the main foci of religious life, knowledge, and education, as well as centers of economic and social development.

legatus_natus.name: Legatus Natus
legatus_natus.desc: We are the Pope's representative north of the Alps!

primas_germaniae.name: Primas Germaniae
primas_germaniae.desc: We hold the prestigious title of Primas Germaniae, distinguishing us as one of the most important ecclesiastical offices in the Holy Roman Empire.

prince_bishopric_reform.name: Prince Bishopric
prince_bishopric_reform.desc: A Prince-Bishop is an ordained member of a faith who is also the civil ruler of a territory. The religious territory that the Prince-Bishops rules over does not need to coincide with the secular territory they own.

guru_leadership_reform.name: Gurū Leadership
guru_leadership_reform.desc: The country is led by a wise Gurū, tending to the spiritual needs of the populace as well as more mundane matters and guiding the faithful to enlightenment.
